name: Voter Action Project Voter Registration Team
subject: Increasing participation to fight suppression
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
We're not cowering in the face of voter suppression, and we refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. We're focusing all our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Driving voter participation is more critical now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help register new and lapsed voters across the country >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062326_3&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062326_3&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=062326_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=062326_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=062326_3&amount=50]

This Supreme Court decision was a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve. If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. Fuel our efforts with $30 to give us the resources we need to register new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062326_3&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=062326_3&amount=20]

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. clean_body: I really hate to bother you | = I emailed you on Saturday. I emailed you again on Sunday. I even sent you a text on Monday! Now, I’m emailing you again today. I really hate to bother you (I know how busy life can get!), but this couldn’t wait – = | | = I can’t overstate just how important this end-of-quarter goal is to Democrats’ chances of retaking the Senate. Mary Peltola, Jon Ossoff, Sherrod Brown, and James Talarico are counting on the support of countless grassroots Democrats like you. = I cannot make phone calls to each of these Democrats to let them know we’ve missed our goal – not just because I don’t want to, but because we simply cannot afford to. Experts are reporting that Democrats have a 50/50 chance of retaking the Senate this fall! Reaching our goal would swing those odds in our favor, but missing our goal? We can all but kiss the Senate goodbye. | | Dear Peter,
The clock is ticking. We are just SIX WEEKS away from the primary election for Washington's Ninth Congressional District.
As I’m sure you know, only the **top two** candidates will move on to the general election.
**In order to be able to get out the vote for Kshama’s independent socialist campaign, we need to raise $20,000 dollars in this final week of June to pay for thousands of posters and yard signs to paint the district red over the coming weeks.**
---
|
---
| | All these campaign materials cost money. Each yard sign and wire stake to put it in the ground costs $8. We need to put them up in Seattle, Renton, Tukwila, Bellevue, Kent, SeaTac, Auburn, Federal Way and everywhere else in the district. We have incredible support for our campaign and already have eight and a half times as many donors in the district as Adam Smith, but Smith has a median donation of $1,000 and the billionaires, the Zionist lobby, and the war industry behind him. We need your support!
---
| | [**Can you donate $25, $100, or $500 now?**](https://us.list-manage.com/19aAgdIFcUy?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| | Kshama is the only candidate in this race fighting for free healthcare for all by taxing the rich; to end all military aid to Israel; to shut down ICE and the detention centers; to stop the data centers and AI layoffs; and for national rent control.
---
|
---
| | We know from our conversations with tens of thousands of people while canvassing across this district that there is enormous support for all these demands. But most working people don’t vote in primaries. That’s because in the vast majority of elections, there is no candidate running who actually represents working people, and because both parties are owned by the billionaire class.
**We need to do everything possible to make sure the hundreds of thousands of working people in our district know that Kshama and this campaign are** _**fundamentally different**_**** from**everything else on** offer in this**primary election.** We need them to know about the demands our campaign is fighting for. We need them to know about Kshama’s track record of defeating the billionaires to win historic victories like the highest minimum wage in the country, the Amazon Tax, and unprecedented renters rights.
A “Get Out the Vote” campaign, or GOTV, is how we organize to get people to send in their ballots and get involved in our campaign. Volunteers have started collecting “Voter Pledge Cards” from people at our campaign tables. These pledge cards help us organize the vote for Kshama, and allow us to get back in touch with people who sign them after the ballots are mailed. We also are able to turn those who sign the pledge card into organizers themselves by asking them to reach out to three people they think will be supportive, and following up to make sure they vote.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | The corporate media doesn’t want to talk about our independent socialist campaign, because they and the billionaire class they serve are threatened by the prospect of a Kshama Sawant victory. We’ve been fighting back by postering all over the district.
---
| | **We put up 1,400 posters in just FOUR days last week!****Our campaign is all across the district!**
---
| | You may have seen bright red campaign posters with our demands in places like the Central District, Othello, Tukwila, SeaTac, Renton, and more already. We will be putting up tens of thousands of them between now and election day.
---
|
---
| | There hasn’t been a more important moment for an independent socialist campaign like this in most of our lifetimes. Both Democrats and Republicans are at record low approval ratings, and support for a general strike, for unions, and for a new party for working people are at record highs. But these things won’t happen on their own, we need to build movements that are capable of winning fundamental change. Electing a proven, relentless fighter like Kshama to Congress would be transformative for the working class around this country. **Kshama has pledged that if she’s elected, she will use her Congressional office to build mass movements in the same way she did on the Seattle City Council.**
Donate today, and get involved. We need your help putting up posters, talking to working people about our campaign, helping voters fill out pledge cards, phonebanking people to remind them to vote, and putting up yard signs all over the district. Sign up to volunteer today!
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
**Derek, I’m sorry to email again. But I have to say it: Donald Trump’s speech in Pennsylvania today was complete and total BS.** He went on and on and on about his personal vendettas. He made claims that have no basis in reality. And worst of all? He actually believes he’s built an “A-plus-plus-plus-plus-plus” economy for Pennsylvanians. (Seriously, those are his words.) Let’s be real: most Pennsylvanians aren’t feeling “A-plus-plus-plus-plus-plus” about Donald Trump’s disastrous economic agenda that’s screwed over hardworking Pennsylvanians... except my far-right opponent. As I type this email, her campaign is bringing in cash because of Trump’s speech in PA. [_**Derek, I’m not my MAGA opponent. name: Jeff Walter for Congress
subject: Illinois Deserves Better Than an Out-of-Touch Millionaire
body:
There is one thing we can all agree on: People representing hardworking families in Washington should understand the challenges families face.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/kZ1E4cETidX?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends,
There is one thing we can all agree on: _**People representing hardworking families in Washington should understand the challenges families face.**_
Families across Illinois' 11th District are working hard, playing by the rules, and trying to build a better future. Yet many in Washington are making life harder, not easier.
_**That's why it's so frustrating that Illinois' 11th District is represented by an out-of-touch millionaire instead of a leader who puts hardworking families first.**_
Bill Foster is one of the wealthiest members of Congress and claims to represent hardworking Illinois families, but his record tells a different story. Time and again, Foster has supported higher taxes, more government spending, and the same failed Washington policies that put more pressure on family budgets and small businesses instead of relieving them.
While families are looking for relief, Bill Foster continues to support a tax-and-spend agenda that grows government instead of helping the people he was elected to serve.
That's the difference between an out-of-touch millionaire focused on Washington politics and a leader focused on the people back home.
_**Jeff Walter is different.**_
_**Jeff is a Navy veteran, businessman, husband, father, and the Mayor of Elburn. He understands the challenges facing ordinary families because he lives them every day.**_
While Bill Foster represents the out-of-touch political class, Jeff Walter represents the hardworking men and women who keep our communities running and deserve real representation.
Now we need your help.
_**June 30 is our deadline**_. The numbers we report that night will determine whether national organizations, party leaders, and major supporters view this campaign as a serious opportunity to flip Illinois' 11th Congressional District.
Our goal is to raise $25,000 before midnight on June 30 and show that this campaign has the momentum, grassroots support, and resources necessary to win.
Every dollar sends a message that _**the people of this district are ready to replace an out-of-touch millionaire with a Navy veteran, businessman, and mayor who understands their lives and will fight for them.**_
_**Can you chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford today?**_
Together, we can send Jeff Walter to Washington and finally give Illinois' 11th District the leadership it deserves.
Thank you,Team Walter

---

---
In the final hours of this year's legislative session, Arizona Republicans walked away from a real compromise on ESA voucher accountability. Instead, they pushed through three ballot referrals that voters will see this November — a package designed to punish educators, mislead parents, and protect the unaccountable voucher program from any future reform.
Here's what they're sending you:
1\. **An attack on teachers' freedom to organize.** This measure would bar teachers and school employees from using normal workplace tools — even something as basic as email — to communicate about or participate in union activity, and would make striking a fireable offense. It's designed to weaken educators' collective voice and make it harder for them to advocate for students, fair pay, and safe schools.
2.**A "60% rule" that sounds good and isn't.** This measure would require many districts to spend 60% of their budgets on "direct instructional costs" — but it ignores how schools actually work. Transportation, special education services, counseling, school safety, and building maintenance all directly support students too. A rigid mandate like this risks punishing districts for the very costs that keep classrooms running, without sending a single new dollar to Arizona schools.
3\. **A "military families" measure that's really about something else**. Republicans are branding this one as protection for military families' college savings. But buried in the language is a broader provision that would block future efforts to reform the ESA voucher program — even if voters approve those reforms separately. It's a trap, not a protection.
None of this fixes Arizona's real school funding problems. None of it came after Republicans tried — and failed — to reach a real deal with educators. It came after that deal fell apart, in its place.
The Arizona Democratic Party is working to elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will defend and fight for Arizona values. Early voting ahead of the July 21 primary starts tomorrow. That's the whole point of this campaign: **hometowns over headlines.** While other candidates spend their summer doing TV hits in studios, I'm out in the grass (literally) meeting people like the gentleman in this photo, a veteran, who took the time to talk about what matters to him and his community.

Fellow American,I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Your unwavering support means the world to me.
Because of your dedication, I can keep fighting for our shared values in the Senate. Whether it is advocating for sensible economic policies, defending our national security, or ensuring Maine's interests are always front and center, your backing gives me the strength to do what is right for our state and our country.
We have important work ahead of us. There are critical issues facing our communities, and we must remain focused on delivering real results. Knowing I have you in my corner gives me absolute confidence that we can tackle these challenges head-on.
I have written a special, short note just for you to express my gratitude and outline our next steps.

clean_body: WFP's Brad Lander just defeated Democratic incumbent Dan Goldman in his primary in NY-10! | | | Quick update, Peter: WFP’s Brad Lander just defeated Democratic incumbent Dan Goldman in his primary for New York’s 10th Congressional District. **Voters in every corner of the district responded to a campaign rooted in the struggles millions of people know all too well: paychecks that don't stretch as far as they used to, rents that keep going up, and the feeling that no matter how hard you work, it's getting harder to get ahead. And New Yorkers aren't alone. The same story is playing out across the country. Voters have been rejecting the idea that a handful of wealthy corporations should have more power than millions of ordinary people. And they're choosing leaders like Brad who are willing to fight back. That's why Working Families Party champions have been winning races across the country. But we're not done yet. While we celebrate tonight, organizers are already hard at work preparing for critical congressional primaries in Colorado, Michigan, and other key races still ahead of us. It can be easy to feel cynical about politics right now, Peter. Every day, working families are asked to pay more for groceries, rent, childcare, and healthcare while billionaires and corporations tighten their grip on our economy and our politics. But nights like this remind us that another future is possible. Brad's win is the latest in a string of victories for Working Families Party champions running for Congress across the country. Voters are rejecting a politics that says working people should settle for less while billionaires get more. They're choosing leaders who understand what it means to struggle with rising costs, impossible rents, crushing medical bills, and the fear that the next generation may be worse off than the last. Now we need to keep going. If you want to see more Working Families Party champions like Brad Lander , Analilia Mejia , Chris Rabb , Bob Brooks , Randy Villegas , and Mai Vang in Congress, we're asking you to invest in this movement today: In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? My Colorado 2026 Radio Interview Counter-Arguments: Debunking RCV 1\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Increases Voter Participation and Turnout" The Reality of Turnout Collapse: In Alaska’s 2022 cycle, the general election, the state's first under RCV, collapsed to a mere 44.3% turnout, marking one of the lowest general election turnouts in the state's history. The complexity of the system acts as a de facto barrier to entry. The "Exhausted" Ballot and Manufactured Majorities: RCV creates "Ballot Exhaustion" through undervotes, overvotes, and duplicate rankings. When these ballots are discarded mid-tabulation, it creates a "Manufactured Majority", a winner who claims 50% of remaining active ballots, but lacks a true majority of the total votes cast by the citizens who showed up. 2\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Reduces Negative Campaigning and Fosters Unity" Increased Negativity and Conflict: An MIT study shows that RCV can actually increase negative campaigning. Strategic Bullet Voting: In Alaska's 2022 races, intense "vote-splitting" and conflict between candidates (like Sarah Palin and Nick Begich) discouraged ranking altogether, forcing voters to resort to "Strategic Bullet Voting", where they refuse to rank anyone else to avoid harming their top choice. 3\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Eliminates Extremism and Moderates Outcomes" The Non-Monotonicity Trap: RCV suffers from a mathematical pathology called "non-monotonicity." This is a strategic trap where ranking a candidate higher can actually cause them to lose. Gaming the System: This pathology forces voters to gamble on polling data and manipulate their rankings rather than voting their true conscience, creating a total illusion of true consensus. 4\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Empowers Swing, Unaffiliated, and Third-Party Voters" The Collapse of Third Parties: The "jungle primary" acts as a functional gatekeeper. Instead of helping third parties, third-party representation in Alaska completely collapsed under RCV, dropping from five candidates in 2020 to zero in 2022. Socioeconomic Stratification: RCV functions as an elitist system that rewards the highly educated while marginalizing vulnerable populations. A University of Pennsylvania study of 3.09 million ballots showed: The Wealth Gap: In Oakland, CA, error rates in poor minority communities reached as high as 25% (1 in 4 ballots), compared to just 1 in 15 in rich white communities. Rural Disenfranchisement: In Alaska, 1 in 8 rural Alaskan Natives suffered premature ballot exhaustion. Elderly Withdrawal: For older voters, the psychological burden of having to "keep learning" a new system leads to total withdrawal from the democratic process. 5\. Countering the Claim: "RCV is a Necessary Change and Modern Upgrade" Staggering Taxpayer Costs: It is not a neutral upgrade; it is a fiscal burden. In Alaska, the average election cost surged 328%, ballooning from $3.3 million to $11.1 million. Voter education costs alone experienced a 2,000% explosion, jumping from $150,000 to $3.1 million just to mitigate ballot errors. Vendor and Software Dependency: The system locks states into heavy vendor dependencies, including $4 million every five years for Dominion software upgrades and a $75,000 annual access fee for RCV-specific software tabulations. The National Rejection: There is a growing national consensus against this system. A long list of states have already moved to ban or reject RCV, including Florida, Tennessee, South Dakota, Idaho, Montana, Arizona, and many others. Summary Table for Quick Reference Proponent Claim The Forensic Reality Increases Turnout Alaska 2022 saw record-low general turnout (44.3%). Ends Negative Campaigning MIT studies show increased intra-party conflict and negativity. Empowers Third Parties Third-party candidates in Alaska dropped from 5 to 0. Simplicity & Fairness Caused a 2,000% voter education budget spike; 25% error rate in minority zones. Majority Rule Uses "Manufactured Majorities" by discarding thousands of exhausted ballots.

It’s Cait Conley. I am humbled and honored to write to you for the first time as the Democratic nominee for Congress in NY-17. Thank you to the voters of New York’s 17th district who trusted me with their vote. And to everyone who voted for another candidate, I look forward to earning your support in this movement for a better Hudson Valley. **We are united now by something much bigger than any one campaign: the fight to defeat Mike Lawler, take back the House, and deliver for the working families of the Hudson Valley.** My entire career, I have stepped up to solve some of the toughest problems facing our country and delivered results when it mattered most. I spent 16 years in the Army, deployed six times overseas to keep our families safe. I’ve gone from the battlefield to the Situation Room when the stakes were life and death, and I sure as hell am not afraid of a lifelong political hack like Mike Lawler. Mike Lawler has had four years to fight for this district. But instead, he has fought for his political career and rubberstamped a MAGA agenda that gutted our healthcare, jacked up our costs, and undermined our democracy and our freedoms. I didn't serve this country to watch it get sold out by a career politician who would rather protect his party than his constituents. The people of the Hudson Valley deserve better. They deserve a representative who fights for the veteran trying to get the benefits they earned, the senior trying to afford a prescription, the parent trying to keep up with grocery bills, the immigrant family searching for a brighter future, the small-business owner trying to make payroll, and the young person wondering whether they can afford to build a life here. Tonight, we celebrate. Tomorrow, we will get to work. [**If you can afford to help us fund that work, I’m humbly asking for you to make a donation right now. **About Cait**
When I first met Cait Conley, one thing immediately stood out: she has spent her life answering the call to serve.
Like me, Cait is a Hudson Valley native and West Point graduate. She served our country in uniform and went on to take on some of the toughest national security assignments our government has to offer. Throughout her career, she has put mission before self and country before politics.
That's exactly the kind of leadership we need more of right now.
And it's why I'm proud to support Cait's campaign for Congress in New York's 17th District.
**NY-17: A true toss-up we need to win**
New York's 17th Congressional District is one of the most competitive and important battlegrounds in the country.
Stretching across the lower Hudson Valley, NY-17 is the kind of district that will help decide not only control of the House, but the direction of the country. Voters here are looking for leaders who can rise above the noise, focus on results, and put service ahead of politics.
It’s one of just a handful of districts in the country which voted for Kamala Harris yet elected a Republican representative. It’s a prime pickup opportunity.
That's why this race matters so much. At a moment when trust in government is low and too many politicians are focused on themselves, NY-17 has the opportunity to send a different kind of leader to Washington.

As a fellow West Point graduate, Army veteran, and Hudson Valley native, I know firsthand the character, discipline, and commitment that public service requires.
I've seen Cait's dedication to our country up close. Like me, she's devoted her life to serving something larger than herself. She understands the responsibility that comes with leadership and the importance of delivering real results. This fight will be tough, and I know she can win it.
I'm proud to endorse Cait because she represents the next generation of patriotic, service-driven leadership our country needs. She has spent her career answering the call when our nation needed her most, and I know she'll bring that same sense of duty, integrity, and purpose to Congress.

My support for Cait is also part of a larger mission.
I started Patriot PAC because I believe our country needs a new generation of leaders rooted in service, patriotism, and community. Veterans. Public servants. Teachers. First responders. People who have spent their lives serving our country.
The path forward for Democrats isn't about fitting into one ideological box. It's about putting forward leaders who understand sacrifice, know how to solve problems, and are willing to fight for us.
She has spent her life serving our country, and she embodies exactly the kind of leadership I want Patriot PAC to help elect across New York and across America.
Together, we're building a patriotic majority.

## Trump and Iran Clash over Nuclear Deal
President Trump and Iran are openly [clashing over](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhDAQBNCvMZ0RGGND4SIN3aVNiQysjz0tGNnLocvXRxflD1KPNKM3X7fx5pFwv3_6DRyHOO5wZQJmSON-zgQ-JfAzx0TR7_kBRK8wqkoZWRmp9Lh4pNeoi8UFAAVNAa62nVJ9a7u-WF03tV1o-s4GvbRBtwEghH5uwQSvJxsKdO-2yihdV1WvbdnbVk91XevGWDC-FrqCBTmm8hFx5xUCveITUjnHrSC3Mh9ZNB9CDUIN13WV85Tfincu1ED4BHkei2fIQg2Y_C7PLC-fJKdzO-QfU2ZkyDJz8sgyBrnGtJ3fQg1FcstxIRFmY4Wu7ptH-l3nf132dOonAAD___Mvgr0) whether Tehran agreed to international nuclear inspections, a flashpoint in the fragile deal meant to end their four-month war. Iran's foreign ministry said there are [no plans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ8GOiN7MQYKF39Dl7-9Ei1mSRwtNrKdoLz9idO9wZUzI43mm6_bfEPPPtz_4062bHEOdGamUijN4eWYMCVCV2LiiCE_ifmzzSDBCGkE6HlFz59Z16vdiIDamqzqB4Cx64exftjFdGA6dAO0etv0sAAtsBppSKnRmKH29mqTBrSSctR9M_adXpRSujU9GVSVlrT6ElPzjD6UB238iW9KjYt7zfZRypGr9l8FUwXTeZ5NWNxFceWXExOvFUw-YahgKum1H-IS4sQkfhmFD_kgV3wMWfickFgwLRhiEB4JxRuDI5FcwLZTbdvVya7H6Zl9Nn2l5X1Hzz-Lyp9ufFv4DgAA___H64gC) to let inspectors examine its bombed nuclear sites, contradicting Vice President JD Vance, while Trump insisted Tehran "fully" agreed. Meanwhile, a United Nations maritime agency launched a plan to [evacuate more than 11,000](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhDAQBNCvMZ2RWXw2FC7S0F3alGiB5fDF2Mgshy5fH5FfSDPNSG-k-br3d_TBx8cnruR4Tn2kcw_ETLmPxxgIcyYcOeWQMO5PCuE996DASGUk6H5CH969LiY3EwHVBbnKNgDtzTZtsTgcbNM2yoAZqAatm1tNWA-TNWacKrKFd5emDOhKqVbbsrU3PVRVpWtjyWAltKLJc8rlM_nIC83hnV6UyzGtRXAL87aL-kNAJ6A7z7Mc4zBepYDuogV06gqoBXQ7Z_Qsl5TX40dulHePUT6OMMt98ZtkjN-UJb1wPJB9iuXCayiym7bTh-B3Y4VWjxV9-Nvnf532cvAbAAD__2KVgEI) seafarers stranded in the Persian Gulf, as traffic through the Strait of Hormuz slowly returns. At home, the Senate [voted 50-48 to rebuke](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAYBOCngc0RYAxmYOjiLV07Wtg-x0S_IcI0Vt6-Soe-QOc7fdLd13W8hkgx3T7DDl_XPCacB6FWlDF9z4RQCsJcc6Ec0nEH0WsdlVCmEaZRelxCpNeo-eJXQKHl8NL2SrnO9o5vvp-0w4rQOUyzduhlKyS6GQsmuy6WR__WhFFaCuG0vTjb6UlKqVtjYYJkWmCJNZfLPcdUN6z0yk-Uy5x3Tn6r9XGw9oOpgamhbtgi0TtjatjyjvcgpoYDKVQwNXSuNaYTTSwhNWcozSOfKEfzV-DFL48zEsXDWKbFbQ_xF-T1Xw89vfoJAAD__4u4eoI) Trump over the war, with four Republicans joining Democrats to direct him to withdraw U.S. forces, though the measure is symbolic.
## US to Loan $17.5B for 10 Nuclear Reactors
The Energy Department announced Tuesday that it will [loan $17.5 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAMhp8mbEGJCUkZMtzC1ltvRAFMSWWSKrhFffsTp77BLR5s69P_fz_X4RoixXT7Dht6XvKQ8NgJmbEM6TkRhlIwTJwL5ZD2OxK9lwEUWKmsBDPMIdJ7MNXsF0TApkKv3QWga92lq1YPWi8NhM6G0GLngu4mrdvlosHatlVTFf1JUxaMVqozru5ca0attWmsQxu0MArnyLnU9xwTr7jQO7-w1FPeKvIr82MXzZeAXkB_HEc9pXE6jwL6Ey2gV-eARkDP5bk9ZJi3mOLOJXDMSXKWZzupnRwj0Wc1PiPNUiv58SA_IvZ65Y2q4ufHcX7v1gmjbluI9BeJ_-Xx5eE3AAD__0Uqhd4) to fast-track 10 large nuclear reactors, betting on surging electricity demand from the data centers powering artificial intelligence. The money would back five projects, each building two reactors using Westinghouse's AP1000 design, and marks one of the [largest efforts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLESnCAURb8GOxx4sqgFRRq7TZvSQXno20FwkF3j32dM9g_S3jlz597z6zk-LQWKy0-7oSk-jRHPI2ApmMf4ngPanNHOJeWQbDxeGMLlRxCgudAc1OgshWtUlTMeEbCp0Mi2A-gfbddXqxHd5KfJa9l5p3o_q05Y59xkhX7MIJuKzN0mNCgpRK_aum8fapJSqka3qK1kSqCjknL9ShTLij5c6YO5ntNWBbOWsh-s-cFgYDCc51mf9lgpLiVF_G03iv9QBsOeAs0Xg0FpEKoRDIaS39vOrdso0lGyLZQiv69SXLhs-UQh3NH0puC4FDzYvCD_quFfNweDocrG7eeNH7plSiybpfB3Y_kvsR8DfwIAAP__hQqPAw) by the agency's revamped financing office, which earlier this year canceled nearly $30 billion in clean energy loans approved under former President Biden. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the financing [would drive down costs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O4yAUxfGngc4RXL5CQbGNu2y7pUXMdUx0DRZmE_ntRxnNG0x9pJ90_v9u0y1myuXxN24Y-lKngu-DsHdsU_k_E8bWMM69NqqxHE8kOpcJBNhB2AH0lGKmc9I8hQURUHEM0l0BvHFXz9dglEHvvUnz3SrpvbTJACSLXi-LEo7n8NGEBS2F8NpdvDP6LqXUyjq0UTItMOVe2-VZc-krLnTWF7bLXDdOYe19P5j6w2BkMPYV10z02RiMe6U8nwxGLNge54DllVstG5bOYDReWZB--Pk57PWNbdgpln4wGHkLaX9nonxYx7R4bDF_w7z_qtQrwFcAAAD__0kPfIo) and could speed deployment by up to 3 years, calling the risk to taxpayers very low. Officials hope construction begins by 2030, with the reactors coming [online in the mid-2030s](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO6yAYhE-DOyLAGExB8V7hLttssaX1B34nRBgiwLF8-5VzhW1nRqP55uc6XyHEkO5fsKJtS54T7jVia1jmtLmIUAqCa7nEDKk-McZjmQUTijJFhZw9hHjMsvN2QRTYd2i5HoUwgx5N97DcLR4VG9C5ngEw6Y1R2puRIzc9yC7Ys40pITljRuqL0YO8cc5lrzQq4EQy9KHlcnnmkNoDl3jkN5aLy2sX7aO1VyX9PyImIia4uZPg9IiY_m81JKyViGkPBb9bLgcRUyvb-qLg15BCbQVayIlCSnlLDivleqC3EOOpfqgpZzThTnkvea9Hwbti_Ws_I1VpItl9hRA_e9qfTnxb8RsAAP__0keGfA).
## Pilot Describes Iran Jellyfish Drones
Newly surfaced details from an April incident reveal a U.S. fighter pilot shot down over Iran told debriefers he saw Iranian drones hovering and moving as one, in a formation that [resembled a jellyfish](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQRp8GOiM8mL_CxW3octstkYOHMNnBg2wnKG-_yq72CbY_Op--83GZL46Ywu2_29HmVeaAZ2LMGeMcHgujixHdkiWyuJDuyPxaZ6ihU3WnwMzeEb9mU3q7IgI2JVrdDwBj2w9juVnv2mH0ulkH0OgAFhx6NwzeQAtd215Lsm9b3YHRdT2avhr71ly11qbpeuycLkyNnrLE6i4U8oYrv-SJsVpkL9luOR-paP4VMBUwnedZZdoxyUopOuQ3VcD0SOoglqy8nAG9egsURRdUxENiRq8SIoWb-rlIaVNMn6h8lIBqlbi7TPKLFzCV0frjJGZKXV-Y-rY7-l4r859CPi18BQAA__8SlIrV). The airman, downed in enemy territory before his rescue, described a ["minefield of drones"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZD0yxgND4OASsr30QtTY7cGrHnvU9i7i70_cfcImlZT0VPX-fKwfmDjl5298kWuxrJmOytQayZq_PBOKEPpWhAvm-knMZ1yNNiPoEYxdAyY-V9sFF4kMDR25fnoYM9-nx9ztbttivGv_iHc728H3HtFa6x-oSYeRxi65i6ZHY3utZzvd5ulut77v7TBONGKvrKaQWpHbZ0m57RT5LN8kN19eHbu9tXdVwy9lFmWWfL5LbVelzHKBlVn0FWZQZjmKcIDrojLLV4WYnnsjgXfi0qDupUEoR4bthCSYIVD1kjaqgIzySvkJ_w2kukOQkqnCRrEIgResOwghA3KiDBWaMksnLryPxJzqOCmrny9M_G95-5Hub2f-BgAA__-4EpW8) overhead, comparing the sight to something out of an alien encounter. One [drone expert said](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb8GO3bgibIWFGnsNm1KB_GpbwfBAXaNf58x-YQ0t7kzZ-65X4_hYclTWD7thqbMcQh4ZI-lYBrCy3m0KaF1JSYfbchP9P6cBxDQctFyUMNkyZ-DqiYzIwLWFRqp7wBdo-9dtRphUY2NVFqMo7x3iNZ1TjvXuHnSnYaKzEUTLSgpRKf0rdONGqWUqm41tlYyJXCiEtPtGSmUFWd_xjemm4tb5c1ayp5Z_cGgZ9CHc4-5XBWD_gIz6MUVUDPoj5j8xC9FBj0lGzL_M6K88inFgJmvFErmCRfakFPmI-JMYeGvnR828YJu5fi9YyoM-iqZaT_Ie8qtZkosmyX_O6z86823gZ8AAAD__wF4iYE) Iran may have used a "mothership" that flies high, then drops smaller attack drones, and warned that Tehran is adapting its war technology faster than the U.S. It marked the first time Iran shot down a U.S. jet over its own soil during the war, and intelligence analysts remain divided over what the concussed pilot actually saw.

## Eight Sentenced in Prairieland Shooting
A federal judge in Fort Worth on Tuesday [sentenced eight people](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdF6Zwfy4oEhDd9OmRLNmDCMZ-8qeLLtvH5FXuPWRzqfz_flav5Ajp_03njTLO-Q10VUjiVBZAwpGoRrRF6xHyTFS8RnrCgYGbQYNdt2Q42e1zTY_zebahuZ2nACcM6ZvjrkfvUUcjBlc63o7buPTeUO-7bqpdcY1PN8yM4BtW9MBPKYeuqntJtv3Zgp2UtbQxpLLQw4SemMN8ZNfVB4-n02cD5HvqrpfChYFy3Vdj_T0W7hurGC5exQsMXuMCpZKSSh5TrsOuehJo_d_K206B41JOKAWpqp9Ti_2coOkhUrJheup_YFlp6rvfV2PnOU2oWh5az5P3gsK56QDeo4sHwWLNZ1z46Rgacq8fV8cI9dhVNbsJ3L8XyE_-_41w78AAAD__1qPmmM) to decades in prison over a July 4, 2025, shooting outside the Prairieland immigration detention center in Alvarado. Benjamin Song, a former Marine reservist [convicted of attempted murder](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ8Gd1h4wY4pKK5xl2uvtDawjtERiGAVJ2__y3mFv53RjL6Zf9f1ijHFfP-LD3L83sqa6WiJmKmuGzImppbQV2x7LSlR9QXbCgomqSYJZg0Y02c1XXA3FezQkRsuM4C1So3d7tAaCwps8B42O1i7oZ6t8qRxtDeru-jOMjWBGQalAfp5BD0PejbjqObNzMIoCpFL7Xknpje2LX3Ki2rvy6NLbmd-NqH_CFgELMdx9P7WzhWnL2D5RgQspyRgiZ5kIKbMsWSJzOj_y0Ab5YCZm2yUmbKP-S4nCVqedAKWrrrwPGJKsU0XYdT9gTF9Cfh3v70c_AQAAP__jX-BVQ) for opening fire and wounding an Alvarado police officer, received the maximum 100 years. The seven others drew terms of 30 to 70 years. Prosecutors called the case domestic terrorism, tying the defendants to antifa, which President Trump designated a domestic terrorist organization by executive order last fall. They said the group [brought rifles, body armor](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D-SrCAQgPHTYIaF-A8DgpeYzUs3tFpoRnZRrKZ3nLn91s4V9gK_-ur7uC03iCke9_-wo-VnyMuBV0nIjLQEYEiMJYEjKBvllJBchrJopQepBqm7xUNMr6WrvF2Vn5oKbTMaradJqb7arIfJhzGYsXVqDG5q13YYJheU8g5XM1XR_mJq0F3TqFbr2vS6NU1rur5XJnRGdAp95Ew1b8j4hBLSKz-Qapf3KtmN-Syi_Sf0LPR8XVf9-V04Oqzv-SH0nE8Qej5J6DkheCQJB8cA0mFKcsd9RSryyMSbfPOy4MF4OPSyUUq-EKjIk2LJh2QkyhQLS2AG9yWjw4qsP6-YUizDKDp13yGmdxz_benD6p8AAAD__4k4jeQ), and trauma kits to the facility. The defendants denied any antifa affiliation, with their attorneys describing the gathering as a demonstration in support of detainees that turned chaotic only after gunfire broke out. Prosecutors maintained the violence was planned.
## Investigators Probe Fatal Katy Tesla Crash
Federal and county investigators are examining what caused a Tesla to [crash through a Katy-area home](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCnMZ0je82PKVxcQ5drr0QGL2BlwZG9l4S3PyWvcPVIo_nm5zpefaR4rN9-R8evJY0HPgshM-Zx8eyJsZCfsy9bTkSY5-TLCApaqVoJ9Rh8pHOsq-AmFXpdodOdBeh7pZpqc6ADwBQmZYOxobeosZtnGzTO2LZoqujeZaqFWmtlAC62AWO1sXXTKLvUVtQKQ-SUL7wh48uXhc70wHyZ016R25jvRZgvAYOAwU-zNu9EwHBPhQUMN8-nXPwe6ZR7-s1HPFa5Zn-EPfGGWd4iEQb5kcoPFYvc0o4CBt2bplM9CBiq7ML9GYliaTtRq3X3kT4j-H_XPRz8BQAA__-dSYLS) on June 19, killing 76-year-old Martha Avila. The driver told the Harris County Sheriff's Office the car was on autopilot. Tesla's head of Autopilot, Ashok Elluswamy, [countered on X](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSoyAUhZ9GOxy8IpKCYhu7bLulcwOXyOyNZICN8e139BX-_ptzznf-3Jc7Ro7b8ze-yNZvSMtGe2GqlfISsCJXKowuY1lzYqbsEpYFJGghtQC1eIx8LKr19iH9rW_J9pMBuN2kHNvV-h5lmNzkH6SUGzWQduFBMI49DmSwjfYMkxpU38sBoDMjDKYfjBpHaYIyjZLkY025qytV-mIJfKQP5c6lV8t2rfVdmuFXA3MD877vXUhf0Gv6V2raTqiB-bRqYL5kRAohuogsCh5F-Bw_lIUn9HyIv1gPcemKsyMnT6IQhwuL27PN1r_3yByLnholny-MfC2pP_vvY-F_AAAA__-2q4e1) that the driver had floored the accelerator to 100%, hitting 73 mph in the residential area. On Tuesday, the sheriff's office said it found no evidence of [a mechanical malfunction](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyszAQhJ9GdGaOQ4AoVPwNnf82JXMWh9HkbHmki7HfPkOaPECabXZnv9n9OM9nihLv1_90Y6-vNc133ouwKud5JSVRLkIhU9lyEuEcEpUZAfsT9Ce080JR3rOtFn-BZWwq9s3gEMcRoKs2312ouTChdTwOISyuD93YjuAghAERquiPMujRNg20iLXrsHVN62zXgVutMxZ4iZpyrRsrv6is8k5PznVIt0r8pvoopv1ncDI47fteB4nhE7f0VTTdj5TB6ZhlcJIUSAxOB9PgBIdg--tX2S-PPYrE0g_GwvVGUX5A-rd7nh6_AwAA__9063Z3) but has not determined a cause. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is also investigating. Avila, a grandmother who cared for the family's three children, was in a front room [when the car struck the house](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ9GOwxeULGg2MZutt3SIFxGslcxwIwzb7_R7Bv83Zfc5J7znT-P-WEChf3522yoy8fHecczE5aCafamGCqYydhk8poiESYbTZ6BQ894z0DOzgT6zrJ2euFubGvU7aAAxpHzrl41-taOYuC-N4ty3i5KjMo5RAluWDpVB3094z3ItuUCoFEdCNUKJbuOKy9VJTm6UGJqyooFPyZ7-sY3psbGrSa9lnLkSvyqYKpgOs-z2Rd7WVz3CqYLK5hemf2nlh2YctzZ30CEjt2GzLxKPALFwm5ZzOzOYmvckCW7G9HxUUGdtDvOQBRyP1SSPzcT6G5SfrbfW8O_AAAA__8YZoYp). ## Texas Doctor Charged in Cardiac Fraud
Federal prosecutors [charged Texas doctor Jason Finkelstein](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQhZ_G7hzBADYUFLdJl9tuaU1giFnh2ILJ39uvvK-w5dGRjs73fV3mC-aS77f_uJLnd9rmO71aIWaqc0LGwtQKhoptqVspVMOGbQYB4yDGAfQcMZfPrPvoryI62ZOXkwVwTgjTL96Cg0QpqAlliqNyUUsSFskgTaRVn_0xJkbQUgoFcLIGlJXKamOETdp2WlDMvNUTL8T0xpbKZ3tSPYVt7YtfmPfWqX8dnDs4434AHNURKudQqIPz96NxDjRE2rHySnceFsLCS8BKQ6r4iINLxighk8QkrR0VOuOc1jCNVxXcVfbVx_2VS8ltnDotbivm8nuC_6bu6eEnAAD___wBgV8), 53, with an $89 million scheme that billed insurers for unneeded heart screenings on college athletes. The indictment says Finkelstein's company sent unaccredited sonographers to campuses, invented diagnoses like hypertension to win reimbursement, and certified results as normal without reviewing them. In one 2024 case, prosecutors say, he signed off on 63 scans in about 11 seconds. Prosecutors say the scheme preyed on athletes' fears of [sudden cardiac death](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAQBeCnwR0WjPFfQXEbd7ntltYExgEtDhHMxsnbr5xX2Gaq0adzztdlvWBM8X77jztZfm15vdNREzFTWTdkTEw1oStYQ8kpUXEZ6woKBqkGCWb1GNN7NY23V-Vn3ZDV4wQwz0r1TbBX3GDoRuwHmKl3ejTjrDTqzhic_Nw30Z6YGsBorTqAduqhm3Q3mb5X02YmYRT5yLm0HIjphXVL7_yk0rq8N8kG5kcV3T8Bi4DlOI62MvJZ43wQsJy-gEWdBzoByweRPjvORbqA5UZebgV_vHRYSbq9ykCYOEiHhaQr6L59Pu4ClqZY_zhiSrEOozDqtmNMnyT8t_2eFn4DAAD__1xGgv8), and that one patient died of an undetected heart problem after his test was falsely cleared. The alleged fraud ran from 2019 through late last year. Finkelstein pleaded not guilty at a hearing in Florida, where his cardiovascular practice was based. The charges were unveiled as part of a national health care fraud crackdown.

name: Dave Beckwith for Congress
subject: One party controlled every lever of power in VA, yet they still struggled to pass a budget.
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Dave Beckwith For Congress_
body:
Virginia almost shut down. Here is what that tells us about Washington.
| | | | [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| | Hi Friend,
Virginia Democrats entered 2026 controlling every lever of power in Richmond. The Governor's mansion, the House, the Senate. One party, no excuses. _And they still could not pass a budget on time._
The regular session ended in March without a deal. A special session went nowhere. Democratic leaders spent months publicly attacking each other while teachers did not know if their contracts would be funded and state employees did not know if their paychecks were coming.
This is exactly why I am running. Virginia's 10th District deserves a congressman who knows that showing up and doing the job is the most basic requirement of public service.
---
| | _**If you want a congressman who will fight for real accountability in Washington, I am asking for your support today.**_
---
[DONATE TO DAVE](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
| | | All of this dysfunction happened in the same session that brought us a costly redistricting referendum that the Virginia's Supreme Court ultimately rejected and a sweeping gun bill that is already headed to the courts. A budget deal was finally reached this week, but it should never have gotten this far. This is what happens when there is no real accountability built into how government operates.
I am running to fix this.
Once I am elected to Congress, **I will be committed to supporting a two year budget cycle.** This strategy will allow lawmakers to spend the first year implementing the new funding plan, then spend the second year observing what is working and what is not before we spend another dollar. Most politicians focus on the needs of their largest donors. Not Elizabeth, instead...

# A Message From Our Team
---
| |
## _YOU can take a stand against dark money politics._
---
| | **Peter,**
**It’s no secret: much of Congress has abandoned working families to gain favor with large PACs and corporate spending. We’re surrounded by politicians that constantly serve their own interests by accepting large bribes from the same monopolies that make your groceries and everyday cost of living so expensive.**
**But Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs is a candidate offering a chance at real change. Throughout the last few months, her campaign has proved repeatedly that there is another way to do politics; that taking the hard path can be the most rewarding. Through grassroots organization, honest and in-person conversation with voters, and a social media presence that keeps her constantly in touch with constituents, Elizabeth has shown she’s got what it takes to represent Virginians.**
**Right now, this campaign is averaging $43.43 per donation. We’d like to see that number even further down. Because this fight isn’t about representing whoever can shout their opinion the loudest, or who has the most money to donate, it’s about building a coalition of support that incoporates as many Virginians as possible to assemble real solutions for common problems not just for ourselves, but for our state and for America.**
**So, can we count on you to chip in $20 to help with this effort?**

Throughout the last few months, her campaign has proved repeatedly that there is another way to do politics; that taking the hard path can be the most rewarding. Through grassroots organization, honest and in-person conversation with voters, and a social media presence that keeps her constantly in touch with constituents, Elizabeth has shown she’s got what it takes to represent Virginians. Right now, this campaign is averaging $43.43 per donation. We’d like to see that number even further down. Because this fight isn’t about representing whoever can shout their opinion the loudest, or who has the most money to donate, it’s about building a coalition of support that incoporates as many Virginians as possible to assemble real solutions for common problems not just for ourselves, but for our state and for America. subject: Did you see our email about June 30?
body:
RSVP today to show support for our veterans!

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/odjlidq6i8H?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,

You’re invited to join Stacy Garrity for a special **Veterans for Stacy Garrity Rally** in Scranton on **Tuesday, June 30 at 6 PM**.
Stacy will be talking about her plan to support Pennsylvania veterans, military families, and those currently serving in uniform — and we hope you’ll be there with us.
---
| [RSVP HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/17SklMSuQYh?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | | | | |
A retired Army Reserve Colonel with 30 years of military service, Stacy has spent her life serving our nation and fighting for the people of Pennsylvania. Now, she is bringing that same commitment to her campaign for Governor.
At this event, Stacy will share her vision for making Pennsylvania a place where veterans have the opportunities, resources, and support they have earned through their service.
**Veterans, active-duty service members, military families, and supporters are all encouraged to attend.** This is a veteran-centric event, but the general public is welcome as well.
Food and refreshments will be provided.
Please RSVP today to let us know you’re coming.
---
| [RSVP HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/3VevBk4Kqdj?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| |
And once you RSVP, please help us spread the word. Invite your friends, family, neighbors, fellow veterans, and anyone who wants to support Stacy and stand with Pennsylvania’s veterans.
They can RSVP by clicking the link above or by emailing [**rsvp@garrityforpa.com**](mailto:rsvp@garrityforpa.com?subject=6.30%20Veterans%20Event%20RSVP&body=Name%3A%0AEmail%3A%20%0ACell%3A%20%0AZIP%20Code%3A).
We hope to see you on June 30!
Thank you,
Team Garrity

## The Socialist Sweep: Mamdani's Slate Routs New York Democrats
New York Democrats lurched hard to the left Tuesday night as a slate of candidates backed by the city's democratic-socialist mayor, Zohran Mamdani, knocked off seven incumbents — including two sitting congressmen — in primaries across the state.What to Know
* Veteran Reps. Dan Goldman and Adriano Espaillat both lost. Former NYC Comptroller Brad Lander, a Mamdani ally, took down Goldman in NY-10.
* In NY-7, Mamdani-endorsed Claire Valdez beat Brooklyn Borough President Antonio Reynoso to claim the seat of retiring Rep. Nydia Velazquez.
* Five state legislators were ousted too. Sen. Bernie Sanders had stumped for the insurgents; Trump gloated over Goldman's defeat on Truth Social.

The PerspectiveThis is the Democratic Party's center of gravity moving in real time. Trump cheered Goldman's exit — but conservatives shouldn't pop the champagne just yet. A party running openly on socialism may hand Republicans a cleaner contrast for November; it's also a flashing sign of where the energy is flowing in America's biggest blue cities.Read the full story at [Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/isMP1DEUMNcOJhYgmiJJUbSI8PAvAmQtDL%2BPcp2asUVd3dOGaHKi12pvF5Ps%0ATZC9agrE3ly39s9ljc3YYHzdZ5%2FoW%2FIxk4Nwl2KnSFREt%2BWYuQK74lWO4wyw%0AWa597vws14NfZORhAC3rQD3CQ3aK7zWWYmk5phy5TPAIGUKiZQWgO1%2BxxzvJ%0AcfCml4mchthQIYZwRu27fP1gr3SuidnJzg%3D%3D%0A/12772b31faf91e32). ``` Sponsored ``` [](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/2pGT5aQojCNAXsCxTKikspGrQeNoc0QAYk%2FQ8om2JLb5TBMGChcMDn%2BfiAM0%0ApyqVz4jHjWzldfM7RgTq5X54%2Bs1lv9Ma6O1lnmAecSvidBFAPP16pMdCm4fy%0A%2B5Rb7akx3s5%2FE0XFWabJ7M20WfRcURgSyKMPoVZXClplv41Sl7vtlM78DVbx%0AS%2FUCjmP8wNB4qlVnck340aarOdiupYZ%2Baw%3D%3D%0A/8fc0c4966985b034)

## "I'm Out": Tucker Carlson Walks Away From the GOP
Longtime conservative host Tucker Carlson said there is "no chance" he'll support the Republican Party heading into November — comments made on the "Can't Be Censored" podcast last week that caught fire online this week.The Details
* Carlson, who says he's voted Republican his whole life, won't back Democrats either and says he doesn't yet know what he'll do.
* His break is driven largely by the Iran war, which he and other "America First" voices argue served Israel's interests ahead of America's.
* Trump has dismissed Carlson as washed-up since his 2023 Fox exit, and polling shows the commentator's standing among Republicans has slipped.

The PerspectiveYou don't have to agree with Tucker to take the warning seriously. The MAGA coalition was always a wide tent — nationalists, hawks, libertarians, and the merely Trump-curious — and Iran is the seam where it's pulling apart.Read the full story at [Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/Afrg45MwBLm%2FBiiEH%2BBYMiN2lhswENHyAWKmbfIWdPiftuBHKemB%2FSjO8zuB%0AmHvUe0RmoNQK6oIf8yAJZpc6FtkY4us2PWKnB8njTWHFjGkjMjB1fhHeGKXb%0ArEBTOzOsicUdVLet%2F5603ys66tuXo8MLqG5jjZcazcipayNgnspRfSRoZMMM%0A%2BpQDr4wbIpjyijFcmsHi7WMC%2FdFbdw69Ug%3D%3D%0A/dfc632dd8d47133d). ```

## The Real Bill Arrives: Iran War Now Pegged at $80 Billion
The Pentagon is preparing to ask Congress for roughly $80 billion to cover the cost of the Iran war and resupply depleted munitions — more than double the $29 billion figure War Secretary Pete Hegseth gave lawmakers earlier this year.The Details
* The bulk would replace SM-3, Patriot and THAAD interceptors and Tomahawks burned through in the campaign.
* It's well below the $200 billion the Pentagon floated at the war's outset, but some lawmakers warn the true figure could climb higher.
* The ask faces a rocky road from appropriators concerned about jamming it through another reconciliation bill.

The PerspectiveWhatever you think of the war, $29 billion quietly becoming $80 billion — with the meter still running — is precisely the kind of number that deserves daylight, not a rubber stamp.Read the full story at [Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/LLq64PBofRZ8lXHjQ69E9cueE2015FFuO0M9xhgL73s5seW1O4En1Ax0GGYA%0Aq%2FJBh5xId8XRxtwxVreIuWjSNQ2RBPLKJUI6A%2BWlOPMDjOt9E53qqKFY8KGL%0AROFkZ17JA92NfQYFmwhJhnrufdTAfRzr9SZN28DZcI8HHteKBPG%2BO2HcEs08%0AHLyTzbOL3qY3MKvrZqX%2BxBDjoAmh0AgkIA%3D%3D%0A/f519a7431bdf85d0). ```

Law & Order ```
## 455 Charged in the Largest Health Care Fraud Bust on Record
The Justice Department on Tuesday unveiled its 2026 National Health Care Fraud Takedown: charges against 455 defendants, including 90 doctors and licensed medical professionals, tied to more than $6.5 billion in false claims.The Details
* The cases span 45 states and 56 federal districts, with a record 50 state Medicaid fraud units taking part.
* Officials said one Arizona executive allegedly pocketed $1 billion in taxpayer money on bogus wound-graft billing.
* Prosecutors say they're clawing back cash, cars and jewelry — and that more charges are on the way.

The PerspectiveThis is government doing the thing it's actually supposed to do: protecting taxpayers and patients from people looting Medicare and Medicaid. Catching thieves is good. Locking the doors would be better.Read the full story at [Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/raHIfT%2FybjGhWtE6IgOzBItTjY3ka2KtqVeoV8cnaXu2jol%2BQk%2B%2Bn5fx6D5Y%0AR46rRPax7N8NebVfZ9oWwYDvOOy9SGxS7xG0cu2JqQk6zh7BTBdrGfb61V6h%0A0tQNEQrAz82yJ2U0rxufY1eFgn97Zc31cC0ARrnCP%2FlrNiqdOmByKXb%2BeO3R%0Asje1BO%2BmLhqmVV7K4Qvd8AmeS4tvFlQPqw%3D%3D%0A/32563e2ae0df7907). ``` The Bottom LineFrom a socialist sweep in New York to one of the right's loudest voices walking out the door, both parties spent the week exposing their own fault lines — while the bills for war and waste landed on the taxpayer's desk all the same. We'll keep reporting it straight, whether it flatters our side or not. **The truth doesn't take sides — and neither do we.** That's just the truth."The truth isn't conservative or liberal. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | | • | Brownstone Research ---|--- | • | StocksToTrade ---|--- | • | Safe Money Report ---|--- | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. | | | Friends,

Join State Rep. Tristan Rader for one of Lakewood's favorite traditions: **The Lakewood 4th of July Parade!**

We'll gather at Kenneth Ave. & Edgewater Dr. between 9:00 and 9:30 AM on Friday, July 4, before stepping off together.

Bring your family, friends, signs, flags, banners, and plenty of community spirit. Everyone is welcome!

The Fourth of July is about more than fireworks and cookouts. It's a celebration of the ongoing work of democracy. Democracy isn't something we inherit and forget about. It's something we build together, defend together, and, when necessary, stand up and fight for together.

So come as you are. Wave a flag. Carry a sign. Meet your neighbors. Have some fun. Celebrate the freedoms we've won and recommit ourselves to the work that still lies ahead.

We hope you'll join us for a great morning of community, patriotism, and parade fun.

**See you on July 4!**

Rep. Tristan Rader and Team Rader

name: Tomas Scheel
subject: IMPORTANT: Scam Alert
body:
Hello All,

If you recently received an email from Mark regarding a greeting invitation with a large, centered image of an envelope, DO NOT CLICK IT.

His account was compromised, and a message was sent on his behalf.

If you clicked any link in that email, immediately reset your password and check your sent box to see if you forwarded it without your knowledge.

I set up quarantine rules on our email server to ensure no further emails regarding that scam go out, but I want to ensure the damage does not propagate.

I apologize for this inconvenience, it serves as a reminder to all of us to be vigilant about the links we click and services we log into.

Thank you,
-Tomas Scheel
_Democratic Candidate for Congress
Washington WA-02_

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Patriot, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

[**I am asking you today, as someone who has spent five decades fighting for this country and this party, to make an urgent contribution to Ken Paxton's campaign. Give $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can right now.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=c7292b76a50e4b2ab0ae6e56ac25b680&_e=NWr_Z7N1IJIhhrs7cWx9iQwRFguTHD68Alc5EJLjxzfBwcxLmtv712mo-7ZyJaGF3eGXLBTX9IA2LCoEG49wQifJHnSPixDDcBV7YxBJh8x7wthkBsbxSUGv3y9mHsIejW_3_ppANVy_OLBbrSRkcIDgZrmkUWMWS2OhPim_Wy8F_lbFBpI44FX4Ngy2oXFrGA0FeuU2gm7-vZ1IsDwQe41M0Mk0oO_VJMPXxjP8l-KqUEBNpR4XhJ_c3edKm64eqUK1M2H-aSAzmfFrqBd_Bo8lYyPZnGtAS2_y1-gysp6JQUAqk5aJvp9luIMpyh8zKtkr1x2PdS4ZQcKu0nqWGRZXqKnzKYqqwLSrEbR2BvyCsYvBFSpW1JpBOYWlxV8PeA3VGzPRe9C1Mu4CAhtUvB9TJCUbChyAQsTAiooGpysAwAWDA7UdsXNtSuAAn2c0TV6kRfeA47yyDK9ZOVK8Cs2iOrYucUUb3dxo-WnFq3puXp66caHXuql4HdoWFMQd_-5kiZU0NLku5JBDH80lDJXNA_R5-VobCRqFUdojQdUv-D6ALVYZk0CpW3e6UAqD-n_VPGluoJhTuFviBt5T88Z_4p2bGKWEGQvscoX6jheadluAcjc4rmAqA_GAVdwW50PY9UYkjuTCVYJfQV9zo9Pd35h6Mv9t_cWFWL9Sx19NtRC6t8YGoUQzADK2bv6f9FYiD63QS_TTY9HnLJFFo3Ws_wRIieFJ77cmIbZzEMizQwvQEh3mm0kUJc07iIFFQD_vE6LVPMFBFzfr98-fVhKGZtMQ0PDUVokNLoi4WnF9BlqBJr1lrz6UX9dJiIfQfgWrc-Fs3IuV58e6p5J76zrpmTxToLGmGowp5doOuGcFm_LW5RF-HKohNYNpZ0XRsle2UQfUcJGpfJBKo8HMJduZHim3IFInBtQziOuB6y-ZGJOzI5dPLvMmh8bKSDaj7uuAaOCVPPz4-QXVvM7q9fTxHCC09CeFLpOs8eXGHQ4%3D)

clean_body: You need to take this seriously This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously | | | | FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH Patriot, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation. Let me give you the facts. A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history. Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming. The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections. It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you. The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct. Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage. I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back. In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won. Ken Paxton can win this race. President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that. Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them. Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House P.S. | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

| | Peter, Last night, Cait Conley won the Democratic primary for New York's 17th District.
I issued a statement immediately after the polls closed, [**_challenging her to six televised debates_**](https://links.email.lawlerforcongress.com/els/v4/i1sautgnuh5uvg8ahhopr/YxOC2eSW5FhBvHyJkj9kFTdn0vM9zqe7Utur_W48H0xYemoo2yWpDjpJpJrTIAcpS3rc/1iBa85GrHtGCcGUxmZo6JIN5KWcn5RGpITiS4EiuSW-YnxSg6hOw1nBu4LxTWi6f_xm9AnELJtgF5eF73T1I8u7aUxdUq-S9d2D_mjG4ivysT3__-mW625NpMdznuj84OFh7GnHCOamTUVlw1A20J3UD5c18ERYskP_LVM3MHIrCS6IkNB90R1AK9fKBKpWe5K_IQ2YcrfuHbbLTZvNhizIBpFWfGnTL1O2GMnyN1Rpval_cxwZPelQoiqfuo0r7LqX8gq1b0pYvmFBN5PJL6syxKIj0Cre118VbcjXSiReqc-FB2h2O709vjDo=) starting right after the July 4th holiday.
I want this on camera. Here's why.
Cait Conley is the one the DCCC parachuted into this district twelve months ago — a place she hadn't lived in for over twenty years and had never once voted in or paid taxes in. She is the establishment's hand-picked candidate. The Hillary Clinton signal-boost candidate. The DCCC's quiet favorite all along.
And on the debate stage, I will systematically dismantle her:
* Her suspicious AI and big tech contracts, the ones she keeps lying to local reporters about, are hiding behind NDAs while collecting hundreds of thousands of dollars annually for part-time work.
* Her opposition to the Working Families Tax Cut, the law that even Bloomberg said overwhelmingly benefits middle-class New Yorkers, especially in the Hudson Valley.
* Her call to revoke 287(g) agreements that allow local law enforcement to cooperate with federal officials on immigration.
* Her embrace of Hochul-style green mandates and her opposition to reopening Indian Point.
* Her calling all Republicans "the greatest threat to America" and an enemy from within disqualifying rhetoric for someone seeking to represent one of the most politically-balanced districts in the country.

This is the candidate the national Democrat machine just nominated against me.
NY-17 is the #1 flip target in the country. Bernie Sanders' organization is mobilizing one million volunteers. Hillary Clinton is publicly weighing in from inside the district. The DCCC has reserved millions in fall ad spending. And now Conley, their hand-picked carpetbagger, is the nominee carrying it all.
I won this seat by 1,700 votes in 2022. I held it against over a $20 million assault in 2024. I cannot hold it a third time without the people on this list showing up today.
The general election begins now.

name: Tomas Scheel
subject: IMPORTANT: Scam Alert
body:
Hello All,

If you recently received an email from Mark regarding a greeting invitation with a large, centered image of an envelope, DO NOT CLICK IT.

His account was compromised, and a message was sent on his behalf.

If you clicked any link in that email, immediately reset your password and check your sent box to see if you forwarded it without your knowledge.

I set up quarantine rules on our email server to ensure no further emails regarding that scam go out, but I want to ensure the damage does not propagate.

I apologize for this inconvenience, it serves as a reminder to all of us to be vigilant about the links we click and services we log into.

Once an IT guy... always an IT guy...

Anyways, sorry for any issues this might have caused,
-Tomas Scheel
_Democratic Candidate for Congress
Washington WA-02_

Today marks four years since the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade._

**That ruling was both extreme and deeply dangerous. In the four years since, we have watched it compromise the health, well-being, and fundamental autonomy of millions of people across the country.**

In 2023, Ohio voters showed up to enshrine abortion protections in the state Constitution. Yet, to this day, extremists are making clear attempts to try to test the legal limits of the amendment in continued efforts to chip away at the reproductive freedoms that Ohioans overwhelmingly voted to protect. In fact, just this year, Ohio legislators in the state House passed a bill requiring a 24-hour abortion waiting period despite knowing it went against the reproductive rights amendment. We are keeping a close eye on this bill to see if it moves forward.

That is why it’s so critical that we win our re-election and take back the House in November. If we don’t, we will only continue to see egregious attacks on abortion in states across the nation and potentially at the federal level.

Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is one of the few Sunshine State Republicans backing the appointment of Stuart Bell to be the new President of the University of Florida. Bell's appointment has received criticism from Florida Republicans over his embrace of DEI during his time as President of the University of Alabama. DeSantis is likely backing Bell because his mega donor, Mori Hosseini, who is Iranian, also backs Bell. Hosseini is the Chairman of the Board at UF. This is yet another example of the absurd corruption currently plaguing Florida under DeSantis' lack of leadership.
LOOMER UNLEASHED is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..58BFqAbB5yt6fRQ1VnCTRuvokw6oGyzeLDgoPBTdKuo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=203132863)
Stuart R. Bell continues lying about his decade-long embrace of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives by claiming that DEI was never a formal directive or mission while he was President at the University of Alabama from 2015 to 2025.
However, the facts tell a different story. On July 23, 2024, the University of Alabama's official news site[ published](https://substack.com/redirect/143c65cb-2571-4286-baec-1c38077f1a9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a detailed announcement, which essentially stated that despite the enactment of state law SB 129, which banned DEI, the practice would still be enforced under Bell's leadership at University of Alabama. In the press release, Bell declared,
"Our mission has not wavered, and we remain committed to our institutional goals to welcome all, serve all and see all thrive and succeed," while unveiling the rebranded "Division of Opportunities, Connections and Success."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41178cda-cf3f-45c0-9413-0b0687f85a72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Dr. Bell's vast experience, solid character and strong leadership ability will be critical in taking UF to the very highest ranks of U.S. higher education," said Mori Hosseini, UF Board of Trustees Chair." | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- It seems as though Hosseini has poured money into Florida Governor Ron DeSantis' coffers to ensure that DeSantis supports his decisions. FEC records show Hosseini's company, ICI Homes Residential Holdings LLC, donated $250,000 to Ron DeSantis' failed 2024 presidential campaign against President Donald Trump via a donation to the pro-DeSantis Presidential campaign PAC NEVER BACK DOWN INC. on June 1, 2023. Hosseini also personally contributed $50,000 to Never Back Down just five months later on November 17, 2023. | | ---|---|--- Hosseini had a deep obsession with supporting DeSantis' failed presidential run as he also made multiple donations to RESTORE OUR NATION (RON PAC), including $3,300 on July 23, 2023, and two $6,600 contributions on May 25, 2023. These donations are a portion of over $1 million total in donations from Hosseini and his companies to DeSantis's failed presidential aspirations through various PACS in support of DeSantis's campaign. DeSantis has a habit of bending the rules and accepting gifts from Hosseini. Dr. Bell did much to elevate the University of Alabama when he was the president in Tuscaloosa and I have no doubt that he will help UF reach new heights during his tenure in Gainesville. DeSantis' continued support of Hosseini has allowed him to rise to the influential position of Board Chairman at UF. | | ---|---|--- UF Board Chairman Mori Hosseini has used his power at the University of Florida to fiercely advocate for DEI. Hosseini was a strong supporter of the failed University of Florida president nominee Santa J. Ono. The Board of Governors rejected Ono in a 10 to 6 vote primarily over his pro-DEI record at the University of Michigan. Santa Ono has publicly criticized the Trump administration over its efforts to curb DEI programs in higher education. In April 2025, Ono initially signed a letter from over 600 university presidents accusing the Trump administration of "unprecedented government overreach and political interference." Ono then unsinged his name to the in an apparent attempt to pull a fast one over Univeristy of Florida officials, as Ono is committed to supporting DEI. | | ---|---|--- During his time at the University of Michigan, Ono, "Racism is one of America's original sins, and the University of Michigan has not been immune." | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Mori Hosseini is also helping run the University of Florida's UF Health Jacksonville. Just four days later, on July 29, 2024, UF Health announced a major new five-year "partnership" sponsorship deal with the NFL's Jacksonville Jaguars. After the partnership was announced, Hosseini was in Florida media praising the deal, "The University of Florida has big plans with Jacksonville, and our partnership with the Jaguars is just the start. We're excited about the future." | | ---|---|--- One thing is for certain, Ron DeSantis and his cronies have done awful things to the state of Florida, which is one of the reasons why he was rejected by the American people when he ran for President in 2024.
