body:
This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Peter, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

[**I am asking you today, as someone who has spent five decades fighting for this country and this party, to make an urgent contribution to Ken Paxton's campaign. Give $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can right now.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d179bbb34e7449ac949704d85269ba62&_e=EsaC9a2NgMYyu_L6QXbmest2YDpAZEDkfMXd8oESANS8ketmRwdUGzJdAVFys9wG4OWvQDtuI6hLVl9SWoeMy4MKutyAFBmZ_SjotHjcfBLT6UgDofGLA-YnIkK0DBPx4dDD1fnllgRRYohPU9jl-p0BoMqpW-bfgX5ocXwwJg6UO7jDJirXJ7mSbY2Y1KalVyrrTdKc4b7ynGX3nnlKKBFS5mar-3iYmRZFIteY8yMkJ0E2fa1eKnsXYmphgdr9hiQ3VtywbzbWxcOqitdCDJqjtxbX7RzQO3D4x-T7qCTcFNSlXQGgZhDdZyh18HBXxQ-eKCrYpEBRjwZ_uOgxX4dTIQLm-79lGCzULQ1u-1BxfWc_kyv42Z20So7BmvcDr818vKvV2cG3Soi8HioJDM_rqH5YDXIk6Za_JQSa042pPIoWOrhk75uWvuyc15EXBkWXxcNtJa9ozHvAeVA2JyLp8sw1wLsd2DE0gD9et8j2rcBpw_AcpPYhJczBWSzBuHufRI196rPCkD3KFCOBHUrBQT4Leyvol8sVMJ_7vn8NHdleZExgVyowOvPGsd6efymt8U6XWuW-jA3_iesRoBJgU-QfiWJQbaGNQI-FW-7CUpKRHaN5I4hGqYdxzkci0ZkXYEaqUo2NHdWd_dkKh9mMkqoLYiOnNdzP899SObmHj_adQVld18otmzl4ITXzhJCapUbc1CWg_f1X5C4gz2ATdDRBH9R2PS16xaROMXPr-sd-VbLsdYTyqUhzKnLfOPsqSLGpxka_6f1rkK9mHBY6dCUd1mDaIH0yTJW8OC_qjCjLSISzt7y9tfblx4jYcYb8_ZnaroFkuhrYqStow7OpFbxfdww2s4ETJmsKGCIuNkKDp5GB_5Kw5aMKFnZakM1Fv_nzPbq5yl07SaGCaw4LByzIy8-bPqxQJ1O-yObPy8RIaBrubK4o-Nah3cGfVg6ebqFq7uedXKCdQDmCtxyF-qLBbP9RF8rAraFa9tU%3D)

Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks,
Newt Gingrich
Former Speaker of the House

They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct. Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage. I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back. In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won. Ken Paxton can win this race. President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that. Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them. Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House P.S. | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

A photograph of former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak and Joseph Epstein in an undated photograph released by the U.S. Department of Justice.
Former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak coordinated closely with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein in pursuit of mineral, oil, and gas resources in Africa after Barak's resignation as Israel's defense minister in 2013, according to documents published by the U.S. Department of Justice and hacked emails from Barak's Gmail account reviewed by Drop Site News.
Epstein played a pivotal role in Barak's transition from the military to the private sector by packaging privatized [Israeli intelligence services](https://substack.com/redirect/9c39c3c2-b3f5-4a9a-b36d-66535deb2797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for sale to police states around the world. Together, the two men marketed security and surveillance products to foreign governments seeking to [stabilize civil conflicts](https://substack.com/redirect/95a331d4-557e-4443-9fcf-301c5ad36518?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during the tumultuous early 2010s.
Email correspondence shows that Barak also drew on his lifelong Israeli intelligence connections to help expand his business footprint in Africa, including the services of former Mossad chief turned private military contractor Danny Yatom. Yatom served as director of the Mossad from 1996 to 1998, and became Barak's top security adviser, followed by time in the Knesset until 2008. Since then, he has consulted for and served on the boards of various private security firms such as [Global Strategic Group](https://substack.com/redirect/3b8fa459-adc1-4af5-ae39-ad0759d06a3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a small outfit operating in central Africa led by several Israeli intelligence veterans from the Mossad and Shin Bet.
A proposal for a "Night Warfare Special Operations Unit" that was included in Barak's Gmail account reveals that Global Strategic Group trained an elite special operations unit in the mineral-rich eastern regions of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2013. The proposal, marked "classified," included a case study of the Kivu conflict in which Yatom boasted that their firm's training had turned the tide against the rebel March 23 Movement (M23) and ended the war.
The Congo case study and other communications from Barak's inbox showing his contacts with Epstein and Yatom were published by non-profit whistleblower Distributed Denial of Secrets, as part of a series of document dumps from Handala, a hacking group with [suspected ties](https://substack.com/redirect/46a663a6-588a-4dc6-9605-ed2dcb4f4d2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security. The cache has been independently vetted and verified by Drop Site News.
Yatom, who has [denied](https://substack.com/redirect/cd6daf20-94b2-4e0a-9f58-47fadfa083c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that he ever met Epstein, did not respond to a request for comment. Aside from their mutual connection with Barak, no public information connects Yatom to Epstein.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/908f890b-a702-43a0-a11a-207b2ef850b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

From a July 2014 "Night Warfare Special Operations Unit" proposal by Danny Yatom's Global Strategic Group, in a section entitled, "General Capabilities of the Unit (Night and Day)."
## **" Isn't This Perfect For You"**
While Africa has garnered little attention in news coverage of Epstein's sexual misconduct, the continent was central to his and Barak's joint mission of obtaining and exploiting [elite political access](https://substack.com/redirect/19fca27e-a889-4cd4-971c-9034a29e9444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), cutting-edge [artificial intelligence](https://substack.com/redirect/9f90fdca-c873-4125-856d-9721c271a316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) infrastructure, and [energy and mineral resources](https://substack.com/redirect/b03b3d26-0874-44f8-a2f4-7f95a7e7fc7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Drop Site has previously reported on Epstein's role in brokering a [security deal](https://substack.com/redirect/95a331d4-557e-4443-9fcf-301c5ad36518?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between Israel and Cote d'Ivoire, and a [logistics deal](https://substack.com/redirect/9c39c3c2-b3f5-4a9a-b36d-66535deb2797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between Nigeria and the Dubai-based shipping conglomerate DP World.
The Handala files contain thousands of records concerning Barak's and Epstein's efforts to control oil, gas, and minerals across the African continent during the 2010s by leveraging Barak's credentials as the widely respected head of the Israel Defense Forces. "With civil unrest exploding in ukraine syria, somolia, libya, and the desperation of those in power," Epstein wrote in[ a 2014 email](https://substack.com/redirect/e52fff78-2bc8-4fae-87a3-1f3c5a1c006b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Barak, "isn't this perfect for you." Barak replied, "You're right [in] a way. But not simple to transform it into a cash flow."
That cash flow came from the financial interests fueling the wars. As an Israeli-trained force fought M23 in the hills of North Kivu in the spring of 2013, emails show that Epstein's Emirati associate Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem was opening a separate channel to Joseph Kabila, then Congolese president, over investments in mining, oil, gas, and transport infrastructure. By 2018, in the year before his death, Epstein was quietly involved in sanctions diplomacy around the U.S. Treasury Department's crackdown on an Israeli mining kingpin profiting from Congo's conflict minerals.
In the summer of 2014, with close guidance from Epstein, Barak was engaged with security officials in Ghana, [Nigeria](https://substack.com/redirect/9c39c3c2-b3f5-4a9a-b36d-66535deb2797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Cote d'Ivoire](https://substack.com/redirect/95a331d4-557e-4443-9fcf-301c5ad36518?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while simultaneously negotiating strategic investments in ports and petroleum assets across West Africa. On July 28, 2014, emails show that Yatom supplied Barak with sales materials to promote Global Strategic Group as a private-sector provider of military training and operational support.
Yatom's company offered a special operations unit that had been provided to Congo's army during the first war against M23 from 2012 to 2013. The program trained a "Tier One Strike Force" counter-terror squad, a 150-person elite unit trained for night raids, ambushes, counter terrorism, hostage rescue, sniper operations, thermal observation, and direct-action missions.
The Congo case study claimed the Israeli-trained unit had carried out repeated night operations under fire in North Kivu and that those raids helped shift the battlefield in favor of the Congolese army. Emails published by Wikileaks show that Nir and Omer Yatom, Danny's sons, had also engaged Italy's notorious Hacking Team to [purchase cyberweapons](https://substack.com/redirect/ace06a87-dbc5-4596-af10-875d58fa050d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "[for state use](https://substack.com/redirect/f3dc97ab-9cb8-44fd-b815-b4f703d2d052?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in the Congo during the same period, in the spring of 2013.
Since Epstein's death, the conflict over Africa's natural resources has entered a new chapter, as the United States seeks to actively counter China's dominant role in the Congo's mining sector. On April 27, 2026, Congo's mining agency announced the creation of a new [paramilitary army](https://substack.com/redirect/b827be1a-0ff2-4db0-ae5d-10f4e014fb91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to secure mines and mineral supply chains.
The mining security program was described as a $100 million initiative in partnership with the United States and the United Arab Emirates, with a target of more than 20,000 personnel by the end of 2028. The U.S. Embassy in Kinshasa has [denied](https://substack.com/redirect/2195feff-4f07-49fe-8eb0-00eee9b0d0f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Washington was funding the mine security force. Separately, Congo also [agreed](https://substack.com/redirect/d3f65a2a-73b8-4309-8fcd-7b2c3eca13f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to accept people deported from the United States.
Washington is now eyeing Congo's rich deposits of coltan ore. Coltan is used to manufacture tantalum capacitors, capable of delivering power to electronics in hot environments, like e-cigarette vape pens and densely packed servers in data centers. The Rubaya coltan mines in North Kivu, near the city of Goma on Congo's eastern border with Rwanda, are controlled by the M23 Movement, the Rwandan-backed coalition that has seized large parts of eastern Congo.
On April 30, 2026, the U.S. Treasury Department [imposed sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/d468e38f-dc05-463f-9f58-f942ee22f318?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Kabila for his alleged support for the M23 rebels. But, more than a decade ago, Kabila was leading the Armed Forces of the DRC in the fight against the M23 Movement. The war in eastern Congo has become one of the world's deadliest and most intractable conflicts--one which multinational mining companies and private military contractors tied to Israeli intelligence have been eager to exploit.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cd134f00-5de9-4174-892c-bdc6293685a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Administrative map of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2021. Image:[ CIA](https://substack.com/redirect/0776f73e-c121-472f-9143-b6b6b93cfb0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)._
## **Africa 's World War**
Epstein and Barak's interest in the Congo emerged from a long history of American and Israeli intelligence agencies seeking to extract valuable minerals from the former Belgian colony. To prevent the Congolese independence movement from seizing the country's mining resources, the CIA and Belgian officers helped assassinate Congo's first prime minister in 1961. The new Belgium-backed government formally nationalized the mining sector, but allowed foreign firms to maintain influence through loans and technical expertise, and invited the [Israeli military to train the army](https://substack.com/redirect/773ac827-4d06-4bef-8e1e-ba934be8c0d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Amid rampant corruption and state-sponsored looting, Congo's mining production [collapsed](https://substack.com/redirect/f97fd193-834f-4d94-9b86-4d5025179afa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the 1990s. In the aftermath of a genocide in neighboring Rwanda, Congo became the site of a multi-sided civil conflict that became known as "Africa's World War." The war drew in the armies of nine African nations, and many more armed militias, leading to millions of deaths. As the conflict expanded and threatened the rule of the central government, foreign mining interests stepped in to support then-Congolese ruler Laurent Kabila, turning mining deals into a [bargaining chip](https://substack.com/redirect/d68d0f0f-97e6-4881-ab42-2c897e99f3e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for his regime's survival.
Among those investors was Dan Gertler, a Israeli diamond trader whose grandfather had founded the Israel Diamond Exchange. A UN [report](https://substack.com/redirect/28051811-6481-4b78-a17d-048cf74196da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from 2001 claimed that Gertler made a deal to help Kabila access [Israeli weapons](https://substack.com/redirect/90f5e863-7832-4e2e-94d7-360d491b5012?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [military training](https://substack.com/redirect/a0dfc380-741b-40b2-b262-2822ff829f9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in exchange for a [monopoly on Congo's diamonds--](https://substack.com/redirect/28051811-6481-4b78-a17d-048cf74196da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a deal based on the "special ties" the report said that Gertler enjoyed with "some generals in the Israeli army."
Reached for comment, lawyers representing Gertler denied that he had helped Kabila obtain Israeli military support and claimed that the deal was merely made to help boost the Congolese treasury and help the country fight smuggling by militia groups. The same UN report noted that the agreement turned out to be "a disaster for the local diamond trade," citing sources that claimed no military support was ultimately provided.
In 2001, Kabila was assassinated by his own bodyguard in the presidential palace, and his son Joseph took power. During the spring of 2002, the younger Kabila appointed Gertler as his special emissary to the U.S. government, and Gertler met with National Security Advisor Condoleezza Rice to seek the Americans' help in [ending the war. In July 2002, a peace agreement was signed in Pretoria ](https://substack.com/redirect/a6767bf0-0eef-4b71-8154-60f31aef1c6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)mandating the withdrawal of Rwandan troops--but the conflict in the Kivu region of the country was never fully settled.
After the war, Congo's state-owned mining company, Gecamines, still controlled the mines in the southeastern copperbelt, but the company was insolvent and needed funding to make the mines profitable. Kabila's government sold off a large share of the copper-cobalt belt to Gertler and his French-Israeli business partner, Beny Steinmetz, to rehabilitate the mines. Chinese state-owned companies also provided financing and built infrastructure through a new mining joint venture called Sicomines.
During the 2008 global financial crisis, mineral prices fell sharply as global demand collapsed, and Gecamines was forced to sell off more of the copperbelt. In February 2009, Glencore gave a [secret $45 million loan](https://substack.com/redirect/b8ecbded-808c-4446-85e7-0f0dd930c36b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Gertler's company in exchange for political access to Kabila's camp, according to a contract published in the Paradise Papers leak. Glencore used that access to buy more of the mines in the Katanga region, increasing its ownership stake to [nearly 80%](https://substack.com/redirect/407dfb24-1f9e-4058-8651-47e831c53f3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Glencore declined to comment for this story.
The market crash also put pressure on Kabila's government to make peace with the rebels in eastern Congo. The month after Glencore's bailout, on March 23, 2009, the National Congress for Defense of the People (CNDP), a major North Kivu armed movement, struck a deal with Kabila's government to form an official political party and integrate into Congo's national army.
Kabila broke up the CNDP structure, but he struggled to discipline and control the ex-CNDP officers within the national army. Facing redeployment away from the Kivus, and loss of control over checkpoints and mineral routes, a group of ex-CNDP officers broke away and formed the "March 23 Movement" in 2012. The M23 forces humiliated the army and briefly took control of Goma in November 2012.
A U.N.-backed offensive against M23 began in March 2013, splitting the rebels' forces across roads, hills, and towns, pressured by artillery, rockets, and helicopters.
The tactical unit trained by Israeli mercenaries, according to Yatom's report that was shared with Barak, gave the Congolese army an elite strike force able to move after dark, identify rebel positions, and conduct raids under fire, while the broader U.N.-backed campaign pushed the rebels back toward the Rwandan border.
Stabilizing the security situation opened investment opportunities that a network of individuals connected to Jeffrey Epstein was keen to exploit.
As the tide turned in the Kivu war, emails show that Epstein asked Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem, his close friend and chairman of the U.A.E. logistics conglomerate DP World, to [arrange a meeting](https://substack.com/redirect/a84a1fbf-5ab5-4deb-a77d-5fdd7f2ee302?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Kabila. At the time, DP World was steadily advancing conversations with Kabila for investment in a deepwater port on Congo's short western coastline. "He wants to give us investment in mining and oil and gas," Sulayem wrote to Epstein in May 2013, two months after the U.N. offensive began. "I mentioned to him that I have an American fund manager who will visit with me next time; he welcomed that very much."

## **" Strong Men"**
In December 2013, the M23 Movement surrendered and laid down arms. Soon after the end of the war, in March 2014, U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry went to Kinshasa, pledging $30 million to support Congo's elections and encourage a peaceful transition of power. Russ Feingold, Kerry's special envoy for Africa, issued a [clear warning](https://substack.com/redirect/df70805d-c559-455f-a942-98e37eb36909?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Kabila that stabilizing the country depended on a succession plan and enforcement of term limits. "President Obama, when he was here last year made a very important statement," Feingold said, "What Africa needs is not strong men but strong institutions."
But Kabila refused to leave. His family's wealth was inextricably tied to the state, with stakes in more than 80 companies across mining, banking, agriculture, telecoms, and logistics sectors. Kabila's camp delayed elections for three years by proposing constitutional changes, initiating a new census, and de-funding the electoral process.
In 2016, the U.S. Treasury Department sanctioned several police and military officials responsible for violently suppressing popular street demonstrations against Kabila. The U.S. Justice Department filed a [conspiracy case](https://substack.com/redirect/8a0b9e5f-3827-4e9e-b00c-83113b68432c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against a New York hedge fund linked to Gertler, and collected nearly $1 billion in criminal penalties related to bribery cases across Africa under the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. Glencore quickly began [buying out](https://substack.com/redirect/75df5dec-a2f1-4545-b11d-790107540238?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Gertler's stake in its copper-cobalt mines in Congo's far southeastern copperbelt.
Epstein jumped into a small circle of players engaged in privatized sanctions diplomacy around Congo's mineral economy, which began immediately after Donald Trump's 2016 presidential election victory over Hillary Clinton.
In December 2016, Kabila hired an Israeli defense-security and surveillance firm, Mer Security and Communication Systems, to [lobby the new administration](https://substack.com/redirect/25677a9e-5c57-46d5-8678-b2914ba6c48c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against additional sanctions. In the first year of Trump's first term, the Treasury Department ratcheted the pressure on Kabila by sanctioning Gertler, who had become an indispensable political intermediary to Congo's mineral economy. Treasury officials claimed Gertler used his friendship with Kabila to manipulate mining and oil deals, causing the Congo government to lose more than $1 billion from underpriced asset sales.
Kabila tried to show outside investors and Washington that his government remained the essential custodian of Congo's mineral wealth. In March 2018, he asked Sulayem, the chairman of DP World, to immediately come to Kinshasa to sign a concession agreement for the Banana port at the mouth of the Congo River on the Atlantic coastline. The sudden meeting caused Sulayem to [cancel](https://substack.com/redirect/47b7ebb1-9160-447c-a228-3b323824861e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a planned appointment with Epstein in New York that week.
One month later, in April 2018, Glencore's Africa business was impacted again by the Treasury Department when an additional round of sanctions was imposed on Oleg Deripaska, a Russian oligarch accused of money laundering, extortion, and bribery. Deripaska's aluminum conglomerate, United Company Rusal, was formed through a merger with Glencore's alumina assets and the Siberian aluminum assets of Viktor Vekselberg, another Russian oligarch with Israeli and Cypriot citizenship.
Barak and Epstein were intimately familiar with the circle of aluminum titans behind Rusal. After his retirement from Israeli government service in 2013, Barak became an adviser to Vekselberg, and Epstein helped him leverage the relationship to engage in [backchannel diplomacy](https://substack.com/redirect/7d9a4b9b-98c7-4b09-bdb2-dca8c055b446?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Vladimir Putin during the Syrian civil war. Barak's business partner in Africa ventures, Gary Fegel, had led the aluminum unit at Glencore, and served on the [board of directors](https://substack.com/redirect/6dc70fe1-a25e-453e-afc5-49f2b8393a5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Rusal after the merger.
Fegel did not respond to a request for comment.
One month after sanctions landed on Deripaska, Epstein was [approached](https://substack.com/redirect/9c39c3c2-b3f5-4a9a-b36d-66535deb2797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Jide Zeitlin, then-head of Nigeria's sovereign wealth fund, about helping Glencore navigate the crisis. At the time, Glencore was making [bribe payments](https://substack.com/redirect/ad253467-bd40-41d2-bcf7-7d58b5379588?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Nigerian government for favorable terms on commodity deals.
The Treasury Department's move against Deripaska had [major consequences](https://substack.com/redirect/7fc67b55-72fa-4d3e-aa1d-5bd8e6e8d746?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Ivan Glasenberg, the Israeli-South African CEO of Glencore, who was [forced to resign](https://substack.com/redirect/38be6352-c02d-43a1-b7ff-3647e6b0c103?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Rusal's board of directors. "Do you know Oleg Deripaska or Ivan Glasenberg?" Zeitlin wrote to Epstein on May 4, 2018. "Easy," Epstein replied.
Epstein suggested an "[approved sanction structure](https://substack.com/redirect/8c650a37-c6d6-4dff-82ea-83c43fd8fc91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" to lift U.S. sanctions on Deripaska's companies by [diluting his ownership](https://substack.com/redirect/d6abf329-b92b-43f1-892e-9485817db14a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The oligarch would need the Treasury Department's blessing to divest, such that his ownership did not look like a strawman arrangement. "If you had a meeting with the appropriate division of treasury," [Epstein ](https://substack.com/redirect/38c8e94f-64f0-404e-874e-c776b5a6c50c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)replied to Zeitlin, "im sure you can structure around it."
Epstein had [personally advised the Treasury Department](https://substack.com/redirect/fef25f8e-e405-467a-8e54-945f0d6d28c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the topic of sanctions evasion in the past, and he floated a few options that could preserve Deripaska's economic value in Rusal, while satisfying the Office of Foreign Assets Control that Deripaska no longer controlled the assets: trusts, swaps, options, or debt. On May 11, 2018, Zeitlin wrote to Epstein [from Zug](https://substack.com/redirect/38c8e94f-64f0-404e-874e-c776b5a6c50c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the location of Glencore's global headquarters in Switzerland: "Good lunch today in Zug re sanctions solution. Interest piqued." Epstein wrote back, "No surprise," and congratulated Zeitlin, "Great work."
Ten days later, Zeitlin sent Epstein an article about Glasenberg's [predicament in the Congo](https://substack.com/redirect/da8dbcee-cf99-44f1-8f1d-a221cc3ca8bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as fears mounted that Gertler's assets would be targeted and seized by regulators in the U.S. and the U.K. "Unfortunately for Ivan, he finds himself in an uncomfortable place," Zeitlin wrote, on May 21, 2018. "This is complex and requires additional digging in Washington." Epstein wrote back, warning Zeitlin, "[This channel is NOT secure.](https://substack.com/redirect/4a20e2ac-dd9d-40c2-83ee-d48fc8dc1f93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" Later, he explained why it would take time to untangle Deripaska's holdings: "[Who owns what is not simple.](https://substack.com/redirect/363a43a4-1336-4181-af75-8217922e72b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
By August, the eventual corporate restructuring of Rusal and its parent company, En+ Group, looked similar to Epstein's proposal. Lord Greg Barker, a former British Tory politician and chairman of En+, authored [a proposal](https://substack.com/redirect/23b18eca-06b1-455c-9f7b-3af6746df32b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that resembled the structures Epstein had floated to Zeitlin. Zeitlin [forwarded the news](https://substack.com/redirect/23b18eca-06b1-455c-9f7b-3af6746df32b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Epstein in August 2018, with a note: "Interesting that key aspects [of] their approach now mirror my proposal."
In December 2018, the Treasury Department announced it was [terminating sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/8d240728-72e7-493f-90b2-75874f561951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Rusal and En+, while keeping the sanctions on Deripaska in place. Deripaska's divestiture solved Glencore's sanctions problem by letting the company keep its ownership in Rusal and En+, and resume its Rusal-related aluminum trading. Epstein [shared](https://substack.com/redirect/6d34c0d4-b388-4904-9b53-3043298e61dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Treasury notice with Ehud Barak on New Year's Day in 2019, just months before his arrest and death in a Manhattan jail cell. In 2020, Rusal approved a [$16 billion contract](https://substack.com/redirect/021cabeb-d182-488c-a551-03942edfbca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to supply aluminum to Glencore.
## **The AI "Treasure Map"**
Israeli and American security channels in Congo have matured further in recent years.
Felix Tshisekedi was sworn in as Congo's new president on January 24, 2019 in the first peaceful transfer of power in the country's post-independence history. The election was highly contested, however, with widespread accusations of fraud and tampering, and the African Union casting "[serious doubt](https://substack.com/redirect/ab125873-ecd7-49e9-9be9-49c336018ea0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on the validity of the result. Foreign Policy [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/d955a5d1-23f0-41fb-a4e1-6e03b45d10e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Kabila had [reached a secret ](https://substack.com/redirect/d955a5d1-23f0-41fb-a4e1-6e03b45d10e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)power-sharing agreement with Tshisekedi to maintain behind-the-scenes influence over the country's legislature, cabinet, and security apparatus.
According to [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/df0e7268-c21f-45cb-b432-e95f51aaf6ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Bloomberg, Yossi Cohen, then-director of the Mossad, [traveled to Congo](https://substack.com/redirect/ec10a202-88ac-4f02-8571-c718e83681f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in June 2019, accompanied by Gertler, to meet with both Tshisekedi and Kabila. Some of Tshisekedi's aides became concerned that the Mossad was helping Kabila acquire arms for a possible coup d'etat. (Lawyers for Gertler denied the meeting took place and claimed that Gertler has "no relationship whatsoever" with the former Mossad chief.)
After Cohen visited Kinshasa a second and third time in the following months with an even larger delegation, Tshisekedi ordered him to leave the country. The Guardian later reported that Kabila had agreed to support Cohen's campaign to [pressure the International Criminal Court](https://substack.com/redirect/005caad1-88f6-4437-9e30-942f9f59be2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to drop its investigation into Israel's alleged war crimes in occupied Palestine.
By the end of 2019, the United Nations Group of Experts [identified Israeli military instructors](https://substack.com/redirect/f20700a9-18bc-401b-8cb0-9e812cc6cc7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) training Congo's national army in the Goma area, while tracing vast sums of [illegal gold smuggling](https://substack.com/redirect/c747bc07-1ab0-423f-9e6f-c78b62edd417?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the United Arab Emirates from a nearby province in northeastern Congo. The U.N. received testimony from diplomatic and military sources and photographs of the instructors, in the same Kivu battlefield where Danny Yatom's group had helped defeat M23 six years earlier.
In January 2021, after [intensive lobbying](https://substack.com/redirect/357e28fd-6df9-4d08-b176-da6c50f388d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Epstein's longtime lawyer Alan Dershowitz, the Treasury Department quietly [eased the sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/604fa718-85ec-4788-809b-f0884a04b97d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Gertler in the final days of Trump's first term. Two months later, the new Biden administration [reversed the move](https://substack.com/redirect/a574e1ef-08ad-4bce-b997-e5fdfdb9e4fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), saying the decision was inconsistent with U.S. foreign-policy interests in combating corruption in Congo.
The unresolved status of Gertler's sanctioned assets are now entangled in Tshisekedi's new minerals-for-security channel with Washington. On February 3, 2026, Glencore and the [U.S. and U.A.E.-backed Orion consortium](https://substack.com/redirect/80ce7dd0-2bb4-479f-acc6-941a75f235ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) announced a [non-binding memorandum](https://substack.com/redirect/77701984-c26e-4bb5-90a1-1236fcf02595?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Orion to acquire 40% of Glencore's Congo platform, putting an American-Emirati investment group in line to acquire Gertler's former copper and cobalt interests.
In a [press release](https://substack.com/redirect/749dee8c-5905-4838-a82c-4795ed9ae17d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation described the Orion investments as an opportunity to close "gaps in financing" that have allowed China to dominate mineral supply chains.
Meanwhile, Silicon Valley titans are taking advantage of the opportunity to harden the supply chain for America's artificial intelligence boom. In the first three months of 2026, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Meta spent more than $100 billion on new capital projects, mostly [large data centers powering artificial intelligence.](https://substack.com/redirect/709a92a9-db9e-48cb-a211-c98febcab165?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The American tech giants have committed close to $700 billion for new capital projects this year, while the UAE has committed to support a $1 trillion investment framework in U.S. energy, AI, and manufacturing sectors over the next ten years.
KoBold Metals, an [exploration company](https://substack.com/redirect/1799434f-e1e6-4c6b-91cf-bc71f94e2f6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) backed by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates, and OpenAI co-founder Sam Altman, launched a $50 million lithium exploration campaign in Congo in April, targeting extensive mining licenses from the Congo government. The company says it uses artificial intelligence to create a "[treasure map](https://substack.com/redirect/af1f40e6-3bd6-43a1-9a9e-f8aca77a9842?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" to find new deposits of copper, lithium, cobalt, and nickel.
In February, Kinshasa also added the rebel-held Rubaya coltan mine to the [shortlist](https://substack.com/redirect/d46509d8-e2a5-44fb-8b64-b2bcf32d2876?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of strategic assets being offered to Washington. The private army of Blackwater founder Erik Prince recently worked [with Israeli advisers](https://substack.com/redirect/ea197d35-0455-4185-ad3a-a0a1d1831510?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to again train Congolese special-forces battalions to fight M23 in the Kivus. A source told Africa Mining Union that Prince's security and logistics firm, Vectus Global, will likely be used to [enforce revenue collection](https://substack.com/redirect/e754be58-124d-46e9-8740-5aa06dc6c461?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the mines in the southeastern copperbelt.
The money and weapons flowing into the Congo signal no end in sight to the scramble for Africa's precious minerals fueled by foreign militaries. And with the sale of Congo's mines to foreign interests, including members of Barak's and Epstein's extended network, little of the wealth from the extraction of Congo's vast resources will flow to the Congolese people.

But I can’t stress enough how dire this moment in history is for Black voters. In the short time since the Supreme Court took a sledgehammer to the VRA, state legislatures across the South have launched an all-out attack on voting rights. Peter,
Last week, the FBI raided an Ohio voting rights organization and now we just learned they're taking it a step further.
Federal agents descended on the Cleveland office of the Ohio Organizing Collaborative, a grassroots group which has helped hundreds of thousands of Ohioans register to vote. They seized phones and computers from the staff.
They did not stop there. More than 100 agents fanned out across the entire state. They showed up at the homes of organizers and activists tied to the group in Cleveland, Columbus, Cincinnati, Dayton, and Youngstown, and interrogated them about "voter fraud."
No public evidence. No explanation of what the group is even accused of doing. Just federal agents at the doors of people whose only offense is helping their neighbors register to vote. And now we have an alarming update:

This is how a democracy is dismantled. Not all at once, but piece by piece. Raid by raid. Subpoena by subpoena.

subject: About last night’s elections
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Congrats to Claire Valdez, Aber Kawas, Matt Post, and Spencer Dixon!
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260624-1&t=1&akid=3637%2E587540%2EIx8e9G)
Last night was a big one, Peter.
The vibes were immaculate, we remain undefeated in state legislatures, and we’ve officially taken home 21 wins so far this cycle.
**Congrats to our winning candidates in New York and Maryland!** 🎉
Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidates went up against the establishment and _won_. Loyalty to corporate cash and the elite sealed their opponents’ fate — voters knew who they’d be answering to. They’re done with politicians that talk about fighting for working people while quietly cashing checks from the very special interests making life harder.
Here’s what happened last night:
✅ **Claire Valdez** won her primary in NY-07, beating the establishment’s pick by 20 points. She’s poised to win in November, and she’ll be a fierce progressive voice for working people in Congress.
✅ **Aber Kawas** won her primary in NY-SD-12, beating her well-funded opponent by 20 points. She’s poised to win her seat in November and make history as the first Palestinian American ever elected to the New York State Legislature.
✅ **Matt Post** won his primary in MD-HD-14, securing one of three Democratic nominations. He’s ready to notch another win in November and take his life-long fight for working families in Maryland to the state legislature. Having known Matt since we were 17 and having worked with him at March For Our Lives, this was a special moment for me.
✅ **Spencer Dixon** won his primary in MD-HD-32, securing one of three Democratic nominations. In the State House, he’ll continue to fight for affordable healthcare.
The winning blueprint is right here, and it’s not complicated. You don’t need a corporate warchest to win — you need conviction, moral courage, community roots, and the audacity to actually fight for a future worth believing in. These leaders put the issues young voters care about front and center, and gave them a real reason to hope.
**The momentum we’re seeing right now is proof that this movement has the juice to win anywhere and build a Democratic Party that actually answers to working people and fights back against MAGA extremism.**
**[If you’re with us in the fight, can you chip in $5 or whatever you can right now to help us continue electing the next generation of fearless, young leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260624_1_wins.8QqpMB&refcode=em20260624-3637&amount=5&t=2&akid=3637%2E587540%2EIx8e9G)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Peter,

Four years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade.
Extremist politicians said the issue would simply return to the states and that Americans wouldn’t lose access to healthcare.
We knew none of that was true.
Across the country, women have been denied care during medical emergencies. Families facing heartbreaking diagnoses have been forced to travel hundreds of miles. Doctors have found themselves navigating politicians' rules instead of following their medical judgment.
The consequences have been real.
These issues shouldn’t be partisan or political — they’re deeply personal. They're about families facing some of the hardest moments of their lives. And these are decisions that should be made by patients and their doctors – not politicians.
Four years after Dobbs, that principle matters as much as ever.
In Congress, I've worked to protect access to reproductive healthcare, improve maternal health outcomes, and make sure families can access the care they need when they need it.
But there is still more work to do.
The politicians who celebrated Dobbs haven't stopped. They're still pushing for more restrictions, more government intervention, and more political control over private healthcare decisions.
I'm fighting for a different approach—one rooted in trust, freedom, and respect for the complexity of people's lives. If you're with me, I'd be grateful if you'd make a contribution today to help continue this work. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

Thank you for being part of this fight.

Fellow American, JD Vance here.

_I don't email you often._

This isn't just another fundraising pitch.

I value your time and thank you for opening this.

So here's why I'm writing today.

I just came out of a briefing on 2026 midterm turnout projections.

And I'm not going to sugarcoat it, **the numbers alarmed me.**

**Only 61% of Republicans say they're planning to vote in the midterms.**

Read that again. Nearly _4 in 10 Republicans may stay home._

Patriot, if that happens, _if 39% of our base sits out:_

**> >> Democrats take back the House.

>>> They take back the Senate.

>>> And every single thing President Trump has built, every executive order, every America First victory, every fight we've won together gets dismantled piece by piece.**

clean_body: | Peter, Four years ago, the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade, unleashing a wave of cruel laws and a healthcare crisis that continues to impact millions of Americans. This is why I’m in politics – why I left my job at Planned Parenthood in 2018 to run for the State Senate – because we knew this moment was coming. But the impacts of abortion bans have taken so many Americans by surprise. Across the country, patients have lost access to essential reproductive healthcare, providers have been forced to navigate impossible restrictions, and families have paid the price. It’s all made worse by the healthcare cuts in the Big Ugly Bill. That's why I'm still fighting every day for access to healthcare – including abortion care – for all of us. My next Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline is just days away, and it's critical that I show the strength of this grassroots movement. Anti-abortion politicians haven't backed down, and neither can we. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = My work at Planned Parenthood showed me firsthand how difficult it was for clinics in red states to stay open and provide essential care like cancer screenings, birth control, and reproductive healthcare. Today, four years after Roe was overturned, the challenges facing patients and providers are even greater. That's why this fight remains so personal to me. Reproductive freedom isn't just a political issue; it's what inspired me to dedicate my career to public service. And I won't stop working until every person has the freedom to make their own healthcare decisions = I'm not giving up. — Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. Let’s talk about where things actually stand on reproductive rights.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=5030%2E898137%2EOAkzOi)
Hey,
Four years ago today, Trump’s Supreme Court gutted _Roe v. Wade_ and took away Michiganders’ most fundamental right to bodily autonomy.
We had a choice – give up, or fight back.
Like you, I chose to stand up, to speak out, and to fight.
We rallied, collected more signatures than for any other ballot initiative in state history, and passed a ballot initiative enshrining abortion access and reproductive rights into our state constitution. We also flipped control of the state Senate for the first time in nearly 40 years, repealed the 1931 abortion ban, and passed the Reproductive Health Act.
Our rights are non-negotiable. Not then. Not now. Not ever. And I will take that same fight to the U.S. Senate.
But we can't afford to get comfortable. National anti-choice groups are pouring millions into Michigan because they know this Senate seat is the key to passing a federal abortion ban.
And look — the GOP isn’t stopping with _Roe._
Mike Rogers is papering over his anti-women voting record during his Senate run. He’s running slick TV ads (backed by MAGA dark money groups) to sound moderate, but his actual voting record tells a completely different story. Let’s look at the facts:
* Rogers celebrated the Dobbs decision that overturned _Roe v. Wade_.

* Rogers voted for national abortion bans

* Rogers co-sponsored four separate bills to define human life as beginning at conception. If passed, those fetal personhood bills would effectively criminalize IVF treatments and everyday contraception like IUDs and Plan B.

* Rogers got $4.5 million in support from SBA Pro-Life America, an extreme group that requires its candidates to back federal abortion restrictions.

Right now, we need to close the gap between where we are and where we need to be.
We have to make sure every single voter in Michigan knows exactly what he voted for. [**Will you give what you can today to show that we aren't going to sit back and let him rewrite his record? Every dollar goes straight into getting these facts in front of Michigan voters.**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-june2026.Nocb4p&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260624_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=5030%2E898137%2EOAkzOi)

Look, I’m proud that together, we’ve built a grassroots movement based on mutual trust. You can trust that I will show up, listen, and deliver for Coloradans — and that I will be truthful with you, no matter what.
**It’s a shame that Senator Bennet has chosen, instead, to resort to BS attacks and name-calling.**
To distract from the questions about his record, he is leveling a series of baseless attacks. Stated simply, Michael Bennet does not have an answer for why he has voted for more of Trump’s cabinet than almost any Democratic Senator. Rather, he is quick to change the subject or level personal attacks against me. Here are the facts:
Bennet is in the top 9 of 47 Senate Democrats who have voted the most to support Trump’s cabinet in his current term, after voting for over two-thirds of Trump’s nominees in the first two years of his first term.
Bennet is out of step with what Coloradans want and expect from our next governor.
We need a governor who will stand up for all of us. I have dedicated my life to fighting for what is right, even when it’s hard. I will not stop now, and I need your support.

subject: The Mountain Minute: 6/24/2026 + 2 DAYS UNTIL FREEDOM FEST!
body:
Mike Davis changed the Supreme Court. Now he has Colorado officials in his sights.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🇺🇸 Just 2 Days Until Freedom Fest!**
The wait is almost over.
Freedom Fest kicks off in just two days, and we couldn't be more excited to welcome thousands of Coloradans to Castle Rock for the biggest birthday celebration of the year—honoring America's 250th Birthday and Colorado's 150th Birthday.
If you're attending, be sure to check your inbox. Event details and attendee information were sent out this morning. If you have any questions, please reach out to [info@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:info@rockymountainvoice.com) and our team will be happy to help.
_**A few quick updates:**_ 📆 The weekend's full schedule is live! [Check it out here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
✨ The Mountain Majesty Gala is nearly sold out. If you've been thinking about joining us, now is the time.
🎟️ We still have some Silver Passes available, giving you access to an incredible lineup of speakers, entertainment, and festival activities throughout the weekend.
🤠 The Rodeo is our best-value ticket and we have plenty of room! At just $45, it's the easiest way to experience Freedom Fest, enjoy rodeo action, live music from Curtis Grimes, great food, and the energy of this historic celebration.
👨👩👧👦 Kids 17 and under are FREE on Saturday with access to the Family Fest and Rodeo when accompanied by a ticketed adult, making it one of the best family-friendly values of the weekend. Bring the whole crew and make a day of it!

🎥 Want a preview of what's coming? We've been sharing video messages from many of our Freedom Fest speakers and performers—like the one of Curtis Grimes below! Head over to our [YouTube channel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) page to hear directly from the people you'll see on stage this weekend.
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Whether you're joining us for the full weekend, the gala, or the rodeo, we can't wait to celebrate with you.
**[June 26-27 | Douglas County Fairgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
🎟️ **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, June 24, 2026.
– Team RMV
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Mike Davis changed the Supreme Court. Now he has Colorado officials in his sights.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
On the morning Tina Peters walked out of a Colorado prison, Mike Davis was already filing paperwork.
The referral went to the Department of Justice before the cameras left. It named four Colorado officials — Mesa County District Judge Matthew Barrett, Attorney General Phil Weiser, Mesa County District Attorney Dan Rubinstein, and Secretary of State Jena Griswold — and called on Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights Harmeet Dhillon to open a federal criminal investigation into the prosecution that put Peters away.
Davis didn’t wait for a press cycle. He didn’t wait for the right moment. “The message had to land while the cameras were still on, while the story was still live,” he told RMV. That’s how he operates. And on Friday, June 26, he brings that approach to the main stage at RMV’s Freedom Fest at the Douglas County Fairgrounds in Castle Rock.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.** Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. _America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._ Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[She circled his photo in seventh grade. For America’s 250th, she’s taking his name to Washington](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Rahna Autrey of Fruita was 12 years old in 1972 when she and her mother each took a bracelet for a missing serviceman:** hers was engraved with S/Sgt. Sandy Sanderlin, lost over Vietnam on Dec. 2, 1969 — she wore it five years until it broke, kept the pieces, and carried his name in her heart for over 50 years.
* **She eventually learned Sandy died at 26 when his UH-1B Huey went down in a region called the "graveyard of helicopters":** his remains were returned by Vietnam in 1989, identified in 1990, and he is buried at Arlington National Cemetery — his name engraved on the Vietnam Wall at Panel 15W, Line 18, where Autrey will make a rubbing to bring home.
* **This week Autrey leaves for Washington with her husband, son, daughter-in-law, and four grandchildren:** wearing a replica bracelet ordered for the trip, she will find his grave at Arlington, honor the men "spit on" when they came home, and says Sandy represents not just one soldier — "he died young, and we lost a lot."

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Colorado’s main suer runs on Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY TOM ANTHONY | COMMENTARY | JUNE 22** _According to Tucker Carlson interviewee Joe Kent, erstwhile Director of Counterterrorism, it was Netanyahu that induced the US to attack Iran. Of course Trump is taking the blame and that goes with being President, as executive decisions have their consequences. High gas prices aren’t popular with too many people (we’re excepting the ones who own oil wells) and so being anti-Trump has gotten somewhat easier on both sides of the aisle._
__
**[From peer-review scandal to cultural warning: Dr. James Lindsay comes to Freedom Fest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 22** _James Lindsay voted for Democrats into his thirties. He will tell you that himself, and he’ll tell you exactly why. He knew he disliked George W. Bush. He knew Bush was a Republican. The other side, he figured, must be better. “That was the depth of my political analysis right there,” Lindsay said._

**[The Deference Weapon: Ring Around the Rosie and the Second Mile](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JUNE 22** _Most of us learned Ring Around the Rosie before we learned how to tie our shoes. We held hands, spun in circles, laughed, and then intentionally fell to the ground together. Nobody was trying to win. Nobody was competing for attention. Nobody was demanding their rights. For a few brief moments, everyone moved together...Then we grew up!_
__

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|
---
|
---
👟**DID YOU KNOW?** In 1991, Wellington Webb ran a massive underdog campaign for Mayor of Denver. Lacking the fundraising power of his opponents, he famously launched a "Sneaker Campaign," walking door-to-door through almost every neighborhood in the city. He wore out his shoes, won the election, became Denver's first Black mayor, and a pair of his campaign sneakers is reportedly buried inside a local time capsule.
|
---
**CARTOON OF THE DAY**
|
---
**QUOTE OF THE DAY** _"Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms—to choose one’s attitude in any given set of circumstances, to choose one’s own way."_ – Viktor Frankl
|

He wore out his shoes, won the election, became Denver's first Black mayor, and a pair of his campaign sneakers is reportedly buried inside a local time capsule. | CARTOON OF THE DAY | QUOTE OF THE DAY "Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms—to choose one’s attitude in any given set of circumstances, to choose one’s own way." – Viktor Frankl | | | | ---|---|--- Did a friend forward you this email? | A product of Rocky Mountain Voice, Inc. 8200 S Quebec St, STE A3601 Centennial, CO 80112 This message was originally sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com Before you click the link below... name: Tim Walz
subject: It’s not about wearing Carhartt and changing your own oil.
body:
We don’t want to win just to win; we want to win to enact policies that improve people’s lives.
#
On Day 1 of launching Small Town PAC, I went on MS NOW to spread the word and talk about why we need to build the infrastructure to elect more Democrats in rural communities across the country.
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260624_partner_ms_gh_em_leftnet.rigcZS&refcode=em20260624-1671&amount=5&t=1&akid=1671%2E2118727%2Er_BQCn)
When I first ran for office, I was a 40-year-old school teacher who had absolutely zero political experience. I never attended a rally. I never attended a caucus. I voted, and that was about it.
**There are people out there who I know should be in Congress, who should be mayor, who should be vice presidential candidates.**_But they won’t if the infrastructure is not there._
In Minnesota, I had the advantage that people like the late Senator Paul Wellstone built organizations like Wellstone Action that took and trained me. They put a screen door in the middle of an auditorium on a Saturday, and had us knock on it and practice how to door-knock and talk to people.
We need to build more of that infrastructure and organization.
And it can’t be about holding power for the sake of holding power: it has to be about passing things like universal healthcare and strong public schools. We don’t want to win _just to win_ ; we want to win to enact policies that improve people’s lives.
**Reaching folks in small towns is not about wearing Carhartt and changing your own oil. It’s about understanding the angst that people are feeling and fighting to pass policies that improve this country in a real, tangible way.**
**[That’s what Small Town PAC is all about. If you’re with me, pitch in $5 or whatever you can afford to help us reach our end-of-quarter fundraising goal and get our movement off the ground.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260624_partner_ms_gh_em_leftnet.rigcZS&refcode=em20260624-1671&amount=5&t=2&akid=1671%2E2118727%2Er_BQCn)**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260624_partner_ms_gh_em_leftnet.rigcZS&refcode=em20260624-1671&amount=5&t=3&akid=1671%2E2118727%2Er_BQCn)**
With gratitude,
Tim Walz

Peter, The administration is calling the Iran ceasefire a win. I want you to know what that "win" actually cost us.
---
[ **NO MORE ILLEGAL WARS** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8yk8NX07kW7UNRAEDQZrniaVzvZmG2rRgOTG2mzVWI3MbLmbsornkbA4Z7CmvB6oZ8GJpjTroe-P79L4gnbvGFVT_vsRfHY4zXt30DuIRsrskNicGOm2Stlcln0gtM3cfi8a1z1hljvXDOoqLstTFnw8HiftCGtioyafLVWP8P8TBuZNeNJAOp2jQZ2n5Y4DAsWcxf3a8xQ4V_-MQPP1FflFWO4IZ7ItWm8gQMXidVSCogmedYUElVfbZEoebonzQQROMrZwzdx_v6qBU3wcjSKC1xxkhYpICW3Ub8Sbz3V2/4rr/MvFcVv4uQlSyWYInC81ccw/h1/h001.uX2RQ4Cvm1d0E9BifrE8TfTOkINJ3-_LyJQCyFn9SyQ)
---
This was an illegal war that cost 15 American servicemembers their lives and wasted a billion dollars a day of our tax money. **That money could have done real good at home if it weren't for a president whose plastic patriotism cares more about looking tough than being smart.** Bases across the region are torn up badly enough that the repair bill runs into the billions and the timeline runs into years. Thousands of Iranian civilians died, including hundreds of kids. And now the peace deal reportedly comes with up to $300 billion in incentives to rebuild the same region we just spent all that blood and money tearing apart. **After all of this chaos, the deal looks almost exactly like where we were headed through diplomacy before anyone fired a shot.** We paid for an outcome we could have gotten for free, and we paid in the lives of servicemembers who are never coming home. [**Help us send a veteran to Congress who knows that real strength is having the wisdom to keep us out of a war instead of the infantile itch to start one.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8yk8NX07kW7UNRAEDQZrniaVzvZmG2rRgOTG2mzVWI3MrzR25AzhdaRm1EhDHRmON6hknDDjbR2r4GI7v5yUTiJd91dHykFW4xXaGlbqocOoWfPVANCS8xqSDT5FDzgMo44scDSv6AotpzUoy98CWLp0Bn1Ol9CU_LOTEdsDYOPCI3Il0jODS-C-x5vkseApn12Z2-BCSV_4zvK0n9AGSzVSeYcJagLqnd-K3kwjGYSpRc_VryV97EshctO3cMTSxkRl7liH59jPiotw73CZ_Od_8BEaOOEXVwOzRsQ9AKte/4rr/MvFcVv4uQlSyWYInC81ccw/h2/h001.K6LPZ6rqMH3XJ-54cSq-SQBDz8fRsB6hzAMgL0zCr8E) I spent 20 years in uniform and I have watched a lot of leaders make hard calls under pressure. What I have never seen until now is an administration this careless with the lives of the people it commands. The most unqualified Secretary of Defense this country has ever had, working for the most corrupt president we have ever had, dragged us into a war with no plan and no authorization from Congress. The damage from that does not disappear with a ceasefire. Our allies trust us less. The next generation of Iranians grew up watching us bomb their schools. Violence like that has a way of feeding on itself. It radicalizes the next generation, sows the seeds of the next conflict, and leaves our kids and grandkids to pay a bill we are running up right now. **Keith Self could have done something.** He has a vote, a voice, and a seat on the Foreign Affairs Committee. Every single time, he picked Trump over the oath he swore. [**Somebody owes the American people accountability for this disaster. Help us flip this seat and go get it.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8yk8NX07kW7UNRAEDQZrniaVzvZmG2rRgOTG2mzVWI3MEDd06p5vYam3kvt9ySRLQS7PfglbEujUjcRMXXUrtIi1GirgdAtouftKyoUMzVONwMsszVn3nHKHiutoq15BNkFSKF-bQWUvGl-Rf1Yw-sA8yn61qF5OAwabGlMl-K8tlQNgW9doTP-uNBfu6VcDQG0s1k_8yGJsCEByP_hdGnjRPjycaaqgh5J5Pk8AVJf8SlpM6G3Chg9uMEubA-C2SC-1I8_6ejHV9BkXKju_DBohaZv7OTB43ma0sOXOWP_s/4rr/MvFcVv4uQlSyWYInC81ccw/h3/h001.2XvlE1fhKCvdEIFHPyaOQkMrrIjORJgp5D_v0tLOPm8) Very respectfully, Evan Hunt Democratic Nominee TX-03

clean_body: A combat veteran on an illegal war we never had to fight. | | Peter, The administration is calling the Iran ceasefire a win. I want you to know what that "win" actually cost us. This was an illegal war that cost 15 American servicemembers their lives and wasted a billion dollars a day of our tax money. That money could have done real good at home if it weren't for a president whose plastic patriotism cares more about looking tough than being smart. Bases across the region are torn up badly enough that the repair bill runs into the billions and the timeline runs into years. Thousands of Iranian civilians died, including hundreds of kids. And now the peace deal reportedly comes with up to $300 billion in incentives to rebuild the same region we just spent all that blood and money tearing apart. After all of this chaos, the deal looks almost exactly like where we were headed through diplomacy before anyone fired a shot. We paid for an outcome we could have gotten for free, and we paid in the lives of servicemembers who are never coming home. I spent 20 years in uniform and I have watched a lot of leaders make hard calls under pressure. What I have never seen until now is an administration this careless with the lives of the people it commands. The most unqualified Secretary of Defense this country has ever had, working for the most corrupt president we have ever had, dragged us into a war with no plan and no authorization from Congress. The damage from that does not disappear with a ceasefire. Our allies trust us less. The next generation of Iranians grew up watching us bomb their schools. Violence like that has a way of feeding on itself. It radicalizes the next generation, sows the seeds of the next conflict, and leaves our kids and grandkids to pay a bill we are running up right now. Keith Self could have done something. He has a vote, a voice, and a seat on the Foreign Affairs Committee. Every single time, he picked Trump over the oath he swore. Very respectfully, Evan Hunt Democratic Nominee TX-03 | P.S. subject: MAGA's hollow patriotism
body:
[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1003&refcode=20260624_UFC&akid=66%2E344797%2Ei5_d-t ]COURIER Newsroom

Peter,

Earlier this month, Donald Trump staged a cage fight on the White House
lawn and tried to pretend it was a celebration of America's 250th
birthday.

The ads for Truth Social and his meme coin gave away what the whole thing
was really about.

Trump has turned the office into an endless grift, enabled by a cowardly
media, legacy and far right alike.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1005&refcode=20260624_UFC&akid=66%2E344797%2Ei5_d-t ]If you support independent media that isn't afraid to
cover Trump like the corrupt, wannabe dictator he is, please contribute
$25 or more today.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1006&refcode=20260624_UFC&akid=66%2E344797%2Ei5_d-t ]→ Chip in $25

The rot at the core of Trump's faux-patriotism is obvious to anyone who
gave a damn about paying attention.

The crowd sang "Happy Birthday" to him. The broadcast ran ads for Truth
Social, Trump coins, and the family's crypto venture. Trump owns up to
$50,000 in stock in TKO, a combat sports company that owns the UFC.

Strip it down and there is nothing underneath. No country. No founders. No
250 years of anything. Just one man, his name on everything, and a flag
thrown over the top so no one notices it's hollow.

Many in the media played right along.

ESPN ran a "love it or hate it" debate. Fan-zone reporters asked the crowd
if they were having a good time.

And Paramount+, the platform that aired it, and owned by a Trump ally
whose company just won federal approval for a $111 billion merger,
championed the ratings as "monstrous."

Here's what got walled off into the politics section as "critics say." It
was Trump's 80th birthday, not the country's. The entire event was a
brazenly corrupt spectacle a top ethics watchdog called one of the worst
you could imagine.

A sitting president turned the White House into an ad for his own
businesses, and most of the media graded it like a fight card.

That's what right-wing patriotism has become. Not love of country. A tacky
logo. They've hollowed the whole thing out and sold it for parts, and they
count on no one saying so out loud.

Jim Marchant built his political brand around the lie that the 2020 election was stolen.
He supported a fake electors scheme that would _overturn_ Nevada's 2020 election results.
He has spent years spreading conspiracy theories about our elections – and even has ties to the QAnon movement. Really.
And now, he wants another shot at becoming Nevada's chief elections officer.

| Our end-of-quarter deadline is coming up fast — we can't afford to lose momentum.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5499%2E35263%2EbkoROJ)
Peter, We have less than one week before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline arrives. And I want to be upfront with you about why this matters. Today, the National Republican Senatorial Committee released their latest financial report.**They hit a record high for cash on hand at $48.8 million.** I'm not trying to alarm you. The stakes are just too high to sugarcoat anything. As those of you following my campaign know, my number one priority is reclaiming the Senate majority. It's why I'm fighting every single day to improve the lives of working families, to protect reproductive freedom, and to shield Social Security and Medicare from the cuts Republicans have promised to make. But if we fail to retake the Senate, all that hard work goes down the drain. We can't afford to give Republicans any kind of opening in this race, but right now, their funding is climbing — not through grassroots support from the average American, but through super PACs and megadonors. Republicans have shown they're willing to spend whatever it takes to overcome Trump’s record-low approval rating, and they're hoping that their fundraising numbers can overcompensate for Trump's dismal approval rating. Our end-of-quarter numbers matter because our opponents, donors, and the national press all use these reports to take stock of where campaigns stand. **If our numbers come in weak, it sends a signal that we don’t have the grassroots support we need to reclaim the Senate majority.** [**So I'm asking you personally: can you chip in $10****or more today to help us get back on track before our end-of-quarter deadline arrives in just a week?**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-june26.71Kfkk&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20260623_PM1_V1_S1&amount=10&t=4&akid=5499%2E35263%2EbkoROJ) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [EXPRESS DONATE $5](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3663?c0=stb-em-june26.iVPyxL&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20260623_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=5499%2E35263%2EbkoROJ)

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133949941/629610606/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDhkMDVmOS0wZTcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_37hNYU7ABYkDS7o-aKhakZlXxPV6PZ70y6AMvdgvcI=&emci=7a4bfc80-f36f-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=b08d05f9-0e70-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=15820338)

Peter,

Four years ago, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade._

I still remember the shock, the anger, and the fear so many people felt that day. **But what I remember most is hearing from patients, women, and families who worried about what would happen next.**

Unfortunately, _many of those fears became reality._

Since _Roe_ was overturned, states across the country have passed abortion bans and restrictions that have left women without access to care.

Doctors have been forced to navigate confusing laws instead of focusing on their patients.

Women facing medical emergencies have been denied the care they need.

And politicians have inserted themselves into some of the most personal healthcare decisions a person can make.

As a doctor, I have always believed that healthcare decisions belong between a patient and their physician. Not politicians. Not judges. Not bureaucrats. That belief hasn't changed.

In Congress, I've fought to protect reproductive freedom at every opportunity, and I've fought back— _and will continue to fight back_ —against every effort to restrict access to care. I have, and will always, support legislation to safeguard reproductive rights, and speak out against extremist attacks on women's healthcare. And this fight is far from over.

Even now, anti-choice politicians continue searching for new ways to limit reproductive healthcare and undermine the freedoms that millions of Americans depend on. On today's anniversary, I'm asking for your support. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Donald Trump officially signed into law a bill that gives ICE an additional $70 billion – without any guardrails on how it can be used.
That money won’t come with any strings attached. Even though we fought as hard as we could over the last several months in the House and Senate to push for reforms and oversight, Republicans (who have the majority in Congress) were able to ram this bill through.
This $70 billion will do nothing to address the fact that Mamuka Artmeladze, a 43-year-old Georgian immigrant, has reportedly died in a Louisiana ICE facility – becoming the 19th person (that we know of) to have died while in ICE custody this year.
https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/louisiana-ice-facility-second-detainee-death-less-2-months-rcna349107 [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/louisiana-ice-facility-second-detainee-death-less-2-months-rcna349107]
This money will do nothing to lower the cost of your groceries, your health care, or your housing. It won’t fund your kids’ schools or keep your neighbor from going hungry.
Instead, it’ll pay masked ICE agents to terrorize our communities and detain vulnerable people – and children – in horrifically inhumane conditions. It will continue to fund a rogue agency that kills Americans in the street in broad daylight, defies federal judges, and inflicts trauma on young children and their families.
And in case there was any remaining doubt about where Republicans stand: when Democrats gave them the chance to permanently ban Trump’s insane $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” slush fund in this bill, they opted not to.
There’s massive public outrage over Trump’s slush fund for J-6ers and insurrectionists, and over ICE’s violent and deadly tactics, but Republicans don’t care about all that. All they care about is appeasing Donald Trump.
But it’s American taxpayers who are footing the bill for this, not Donald Trump – and it’s not OK.
I will not stop fighting to end mass detention, dismantle and overhaul ICE, and shut down the horrific family detention centers that are profiting from these human rights abuses.
To do that, we need to take back the House and shut down the corrupt, chaotic, and cruel MAGA majority that’s enabling this brutal administration.
Will you join my efforts to flip the House with a contribution before our June 30th FEC deadline? Your donations go directly to our work on the ground, making sure I’m re-elected, supporting frontline Democratic colleagues in tough races, and boosting Democratic challengers working to flip red seats.
