name: Dylan for Wisconsin
subject: A Trillion Dollars vs. Wisconsin’s Budget
body:
Earlier this month, Elon Musk crossed the $1 trillion mark in net worth. I had to run the numbers myself because I honestly couldn’t believe it.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/788e63db5380/c2y1sg9w12-10123117?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/x1okF3Of49Y?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,

Earlier this month, Elon Musk crossed the $1 trillion mark in net worth. I had to run the numbers myself because I honestly couldn’t believe it.
That’s more money than Wisconsin’s entire state budget for the next 17 years combined.
Wisconsin operates on about $55 billion a year when you add up state revenue, federal funds, and program dollars. One person could fund everything our state supports (schools, roads, healthcare, public safety) for nearly two decades and still be unimaginably wealthy. That’s the budget for _**six million people**_ _**for seventeen years**_. But now it’s also the wealth of one man with a giant ego.
This amount of wealth is not just shocking. It's a warning sign.
---
| [Watch The Breakdown Video Here](https://us.list-manage.com/GUAYA4av0SM?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
---
| |

Right now, our system gives an alarming amount of power to a handful of incredibly wealthy people, while working families and communities are told to make do with less. We elect leaders to create and debate our budget in public, but our economy puts power in the hands of a few.
This system is fundamentally broken.
I’m running to be the next Wisconsin State Treasurer because it doesn’t have to be like this! The Treasurer’s Office can shine a light on where money flows, demand transparency, and help make sure our public dollars serve the public good, not just billionaires and trillionaires.
We are entering a critical stretch of this race. Over the next six weeks, we need to reach voters across Wisconsin and share the clear message that our economy should support and reward workers and communities, not just the small group of individuals at the very top.
[**If you’re able, please donate today to help us get this message out across Wisconsin. Every contribution helps us build a campaign strong enough to challenge broken systems and fight for accountability, fairness, and real transparency.**](https://us.list-manage.com/1CpdQBXw0H2?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
Together, we can use Public Power for the Public Good.
Best,Dylan

Dear Friend,
Today marks an important milestone for our campaign.
Americans for Citizen Voting Michigan has officially launched our **first television advertisement** , highlighting the case of a convicted rapist who, despite not being a U.S. citizen, illegally voted in Michigan's 2016, 2020, and 2024 elections. This case proves exactly why our Citizen Only Voting constitutional amendment is needed.
In March, we submitted **more than 750,000 signatures** to place our proposal on the November ballot. If approved by voters, the amendment will:• Require government-issued photo ID to vote.
• Ensure only U.S. citizens are eligible to vote.
• Require the Secretary of State to regularly review Michigan's voter rolls for citizenship.
One unlawful vote is one too many.
Every illegal ballot cast dilutes the vote of a law-abiding American citizen. Free and fair elections depend on enforcing the law and ensuring that only eligible citizens participate.
For years, Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson has insisted Michigan's elections are secure. Yet documented cases of noncitizens voting continue to emerge. **Current law allows individuals to vote without presenting identification by signing an affidavit, and those affidavits are not routinely verified after the election.**
Michigan deserves better.
Our campaign isn't about politics. It's about protecting every legal vote and restoring confidence in our elections.
Soon the decision will be before Michigan voters.
Over the coming months, you'll see our campaign reaching voters across the state through television, digital advertising, grassroots outreach, and earned media. Your support made this possible, and we couldn't be more grateful.
Please watch our new television ad, share it with your friends and family, and continue standing with us as we work to protect the integrity of Michigan's elections.
Together, we'll ensure that only U.S. citizens decide Michigan's future.
Thank you for your continued support.
Sincerely,The Citizen Only Voting-Michigan Team

**Americans for Citizen Voting Submits 750,000 Petition Signatures** _**Set to Place Citizen-Only Voting, Voter ID on Michigan Ballot**_******LANSING, MI** \- Americans for Citizen Voting today announced at a press conference in Lansing the submission of more than 750,000 petition signatures in support of a statewide ballot initiative to require that only American citizens vote in Michigan elections, mandate photo identification to cast a ballot, and implement a systematic review of Michigan’s Qualified Voter File. The submission far exceeds the 446,198 valid signatures required under Michigan law. The signatures, collected from every county across the state of Michigan, represent an overwhelming, bipartisan show of support for election integrity and voter confidence. From the Upper Peninsula to Southeast Michigan, voters across the political spectrum signed on to support clear, enforceable election standards. “More than seven hundred and fifty thousand Michiganders made their voices heard,” said Paul Jacob, Chair of Americans for Citizen Voting. “They support citizen-only voting, they support photo ID, and they support maintaining a clean and accurate voter file. This campaign was driven by common sense and a shared belief that our elections are the foundation of our democracy. One citizen, one vote.” Polling consistently shows strong bipartisan agreement on these principles, including more than 70 percent among Independents, more than 80 percent among Republicans, and more Democrats than not, reinforcing that the security of our elections is not a partisan issue, but a foundational expectation widely shared by Michigan voters. Former Michigan Secretary of State and current State Senator Ruth Johnson said the initiative reflects what voters have been asking for: “People want secure elections and clean voter rolls,” said Johnson (R-Holly). “They want to know that only eligible citizens are voting, that photo ID is required at the polls, and that the state is taking seriously its responsibility to maintain an accurate Qualified Voter File. This level of support shows that Michigan voters are paying attention and expect accountability.” Paid circulators and more than 17,000 volunteers gathered signatures in all 83 counties, engaging voters in cities, townships, and rural communities alike. Organizers say the geographic breadth of the petition drive underscores the depth and durability of statewide support. Organizers have thoroughly checked to verify more than enough valid signatures to place the measure on the ballot and look forward to fair and expeditious certification from the Secretary of State office. Rep. Ann Bollin commended the effort. “We saw noncitizens vote in Michigan in 2024 despite claims from Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson that this does not happen,” said Bollin (R-Brighton). “As a former clerk, I applaud this campaign to restore integrity. I sincerely thank all of the volunteers and residents who gathered and signed petitions to help secure our elections.” “Seven hundred and fifty thousand signatures speak volumes,” Jacob added. “We look forward to the certification process and to giving Michigan voters the opportunity to decide this issue at the ballot box.” Rep. Rachelle Smit, also a former clerk and chair of the House Election Integrity Committee further supported the need for the initiative. “We know the public wants photo ID for voting and for only citizens to vote,” said Smit (R-Martin Twp). “Today the people of Michigan sent a very strong message with the number of signatures that have been collected to get this on the ballot. I am confident that voters in November will deliver that same message.”

# [Four Years After Dobbs](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=203442098&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzNDQyMDk4LCJpYXQiOjE3ODIzMzUxMDEsImV4cCI6MTc4NDkyNzEwMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.6OHpAAD9xAjG_hIrz-KFDKPGcFnN1s7Td4BBNUMyJNA)
### We keep fighting
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL2ZvdXIteWVhcnMtYWZ0ZXItZG9iYnM_.rmUozWb_FCd7QHDDp45RtN6vpnHydHmQZL4cNSAwF7U?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/four-years-after-dobbs?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Four years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_.
I remember exactly where I was when the _Dobbs_ decision came down. I remember the disbelief, the anger, and then the resolve. It was the same feeling I heard from women across the country in the days that followed - a right we had lived with our entire lives was gone, decided for us by people who would never have to live with the consequences.
Four years later, I wish I could tell you the worst is behind us.
It isn't.
Here in Michigan, in 2022, voters went to the ballot box and enshrined reproductive freedom in our state constitution. We protected the right to make these deeply personal decisions for ourselves.
But the hard truth is that Michigan's protections alone cannot keep us safe from every threat coming out of Washington. Right now, anti-abortion politicians and their allies are still trying to use the courts to restrict access to Mifepristone, the safe, FDA-approved abortion medication. A federal court has already tried to impose restrictions that would have limited access nationwide, including here in Michigan.
The Supreme Court paused that decision for now. But "for now" is not a promise any of us should count on.
A national ban or a ruling from a court could override what Michigan voters said loudly and clearly: we want the freedom to make our own health care decisions. That is the part I need people to understand: the protections we won here can still be weakened or erased from Washington.
The people trying to take these rights away understand exactly what is at stake. Well-funded anti-abortion groups are planning to spend millions of dollars this cycle to keep the US Senate in MAGA Republican hands, because they know whoever controls the Senate will shape the future of reproductive freedom in this country.
That is why this race matters so much to me. That's why I take it personally.
**I have spent my career fighting for reproductive freedom. I 've stood with Planned Parenthood, fought to restore the protections we had under **_**Roe**_**, and ALWAYS trusted women to make their own decisions about their own bodies and their own lives.**
That is not a position I arrived at for a campaign. It is who I am, and it is not going to change.
Mike Rogers has spent years supporting abortion restrictions and federal measures that would have taken these decisions away from women. He is endorsed by Donald Trump, and he is backed by the same far-right forces that are working to roll reproductive rights back nationwide.
If he wins, he will be one more vote in the Senate for taking these decisions away from women and handing them to politicians.
That's not me. Everyone knows that.
So on this solemn anniversary, I am not just looking back at what we lost. I am looking at what we can still protect and at how much is riding on the next several months.
We have to keep Michigan blue.

name: Cooper, Roy (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: Four years ago today
body:
While I was devastated by the loss of reproductive freedom in America after the fall of Roe, my Republican opponent celebrated it.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1900%2E124072%2EHmsSAs)
| | | |
---
Peter,
For the past four years, the loss of reproductive freedoms has affected millions across America. On June 24, 2022, Roe v. Wade was overturned, undoing nearly half a century of legal precedent and taking away the constitutional right to abortion access for millions of women across the country.
I was Governor at the time – and while I anticipated that anti-choice state legislators would move swiftly to push cruel restrictions on abortion rights for North Carolinians here at home, it didn’t make this moment any less jarring or any less life-changing.
**That’s one of the biggest differences in this Senate race, Peter.**
While I was devastated by the loss of reproductive freedom in America after the fall of Roe, my Republican opponent, Michael Whatley, celebrated it – saying he was "proud."
While as Governor I vetoed the North Carolina GOP’s abortion ban, Whatley – who was the chair of the state Republican Party at the time – championed it.
While I’m ready to get to Washington DC and help restore the right to abortion access, Whatley is determined to be a vote for an extreme national abortion ban.
**We can win this fight – but a dark-money anti-abortion group is already pledging to spend millions to defeat me, and I can’t overcome their attacks alone.**
[**Peter, I need you with me. If you’re in a position to do so, I’m hoping you’ll consider making a donation of any amount to my campaign today. Only with you by my side can I defeat my extreme opponent, flip the Senate and restore abortion access across the country.**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk747&amount=5&t=8&akid=1900%2E124072%2EHmsSAs)
Thank you,

Roy Cooper

clean_body: Our priorities are clear. | = Peter, It's Gretchen Whitmer. Four years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and revoked the federal right to abortion; a right many of us have had our entire lives. Since then, Republican-led state legislatures across the country have been relentless in passing draconian abortion laws. Patients have been denied life-saving care and doctors and nurses have faced the threat of prosecution just for doing their jobs. If anti-choice Republicans win this November, we can expect this landscape to get worse. That's why I'm emailing you today. My friends at EMILYs List are hard at work supporting Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot, and they need your help. For today only, a group of dedicated EMILYs List donors has agreed to match every single donation up to $50,000. = | = Michigan is one of the places EMILYs List can make a big difference this fall. We need to flip our Republican-controlled state House, keep Michigan's open Senate seat blue, keep our governorship blue, and elect and reelect pro-choice champions like Rep. Kristen McDonald Rivet , who can help Democrats take back the House and stop anti-choice Republicans in their tracks. What happens at the ballot box this fall will decide the fate of reproductive rights across the country. EMILYs List is leading the charge in electing powerful women nationwide who will keep up the fight. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thanks, Gretchen Gov. name: Akeima Young
subject: We went to Georgia, and the maternal healthcare crisis there will shock you
body:
---
“There is a deep lack of humanity.” That line stuck with me as I traveled across my home state, amplifying the stories of Georgians navigating one of the strictest abortion bans in America. Derek, I’m Akeima Young, the DNC’s Video Director. Today, on the fourth anniversary of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , I’m humbled to share the stories of Olama, Zuri, and Shanette in the DNC’s newest mini-doc, _We went to Georgia: The maternal healthcare crisis will shock you._ [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-2026-dobbs-anniversary?refcode=em_20260624_7724_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7724_22930333_-l4jHJ&akid=7724%2E22930333%2E-l4jHJ) As Republicans try to silence our voices and control our bodies, sharing our stories is a crucial act of resistance. **If there’s one thing to take away from these conversations, it’s the _deep_ lack of humanity involved in not only the Court’s decision in 2022, but in states legislating away women’s rights to these necessary reproductive procedures and doctors’ ability to practice evidence based medicine.** Each of these women has experienced firsthand what it is to live as a Black woman in the South with limited reproductive freedom. _Olama was denied critical care during a miscarriage because of the strict ban on the procedure she needed._ _Zuri, an OBGYN in Atlanta, now faces a new level of fear and uncertainty in her practice, as many procedures have been made a felony in the state._ _Shanette lost her daughter, Amber, after doctors severely delayed her necessary care — one of many preventable deaths at the hands of anti-choice legislators._ **Abortion bans impact real people every single day, and it’s all happening right in front of our eyes.** I can’t tell you how grateful I am for the privilege of giving these women a microphone and letting them know that their voices matter. As a queer Black person from Georgia, I found these women and their stories all too familiar. In them I saw myself, my friends, my family, my community. And I hope these stories have as powerful an impact on you as they did on me. Giving these women a platform to reach millions of people is only one of the ways my team at the DNC is fighting back against abortion bans. We’re telling stories that need to be heard from folks all over the country — stories the 24-hour news cycle might otherwise forget. As a filmmaker, I deeply believe in the power of storytelling, and I know the kind of change that’s possible when a story moves someone. **If one person sees a video, reads an email and feels _seen_ , or is compelled to action, then I know it’s working. Because the way we build a movement for change has always been the same — one person at a time.** **Olama put it perfectly: “We need to show up on voting day, and we need to let these people know that the decisions that they’re trying to make for us are not going to fly.”** [**Derek, if you’re ready to take action today, please consider chipping in $7 to the DNC to help us continue sharing stories, empowering voters, and electing Democrats at all levels who will continue fighting for your rights day-in and day-out.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-2026-dobbs-anniversary?amount=7&refcode=em_20260624_7724_fr&refcode2=7724_22930333_-l4jHJ&akid=7724%2E22930333%2E-l4jHJ) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-2026-dobbs-anniversary?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260624_7724_fr&refcode2=7724_22930333_-l4jHJ&akid=7724%2E22930333%2E-l4jHJ)**

Derek, I’m Akeima Young, the DNC’s Video Director. Today, on the fourth anniversary of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , I’m humbled to share the stories of Olama, Zuri, and Shanette in the DNC’s newest mini-doc, We went to Georgia: The maternal healthcare crisis will shock you. As Republicans try to silence our voices and control our bodies, sharing our stories is a crucial act of resistance. If there’s one thing to take away from these conversations, it’s the deep lack of humanity involved in not only the Court’s decision in 2022, but in states legislating away women’s rights to these necessary reproductive procedures and doctors’ ability to practice evidence based medicine. Each of these women has experienced firsthand what it is to live as a Black woman in the South with limited reproductive freedom. Olama was denied critical care during a miscarriage because of the strict ban on the procedure she needed. Zuri, an OBGYN in Atlanta, now faces a new level of fear and uncertainty in her practice, as many procedures have been made a felony in the state. Shanette lost her daughter, Amber, after doctors severely delayed her necessary care — one of many preventable deaths at the hands of anti-choice legislators. Abortion bans impact real people every single day, and it’s all happening right in front of our eyes. I can’t tell you how grateful I am for the privilege of giving these women a microphone and letting them know that their voices matter. As a queer Black person from Georgia, I found these women and their stories all too familiar. In them I saw myself, my friends, my family, my community. And I hope these stories have as powerful an impact on you as they did on me. Giving these women a platform to reach millions of people is only one of the ways my team at the DNC is fighting back against abortion bans. We’re telling stories that need to be heard from folks all over the country — stories the 24-hour news cycle might otherwise forget. As a filmmaker, I deeply believe in the power of storytelling, and I know the kind of change that’s possible when a story moves someone. If one person sees a video, reads an email and feels seen , or is compelled to action, then I know it’s working. Because the way we build a movement for change has always been the same — one person at a time. name: Adam Dunigan
subject: Adam Dunigan Event Invitations!
body:
A list of events for anyone curious to meet Adam, the Marine Corps veteran and ex-CIA heartthrob stealing America's heart in Virginia's 8th District.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2ZSfMSIACyS?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | | | | | Hey friends, it’s Adam Dunigan. I have been very poor about getting these newsletter updates out, I know. Turns out campaigning is exactly as chaotic as everyone said it would be. But I’m here now! In your inbox and in your heart (hopefully).
We’ve got our first debate this weekend. That’s pretty exciting. Wish me luck up there, and if you’re in the Northern Virginia area, come attend. We’ve also got a couple very cool opportunities to come out and hang with me and the team over the next few days. Details are below for each day’s activities.
**Upcoming Events**
* **Wednesday, June 24th** \- 7:30PM, World Cup - Mexico game at Alexandria Bier Garden. Featuring participation from Amanda Nelson from [@AmandasMildTakes](https://us.list-manage.com/fbnWZSzhCzx?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) and another _secret surprise guest_. Reveal will be day-of. No sign up necessary, just come grab a Bier but do NOT grab the Garden, they get upset when you do that.

* **Thursday, June 25th** \- 7PM, The Back House Studio in Falls Church (6066 Leesburg Pike, Suite 540). Come hang out with the Back House Studio Crew for an informal Town Hall/Q+A. Jordan, Ceci, and the rest of the Back House crew always do it up real nice. Wine and snacks provided. No sign up necessary, just believe in yourself.

* **Saturday, June 27th** \- 6PM, “Celebrating the Human Spirit” in Crystal City. Location disclosed once you [register to attend](https://us.list-manage.com/_iNAvJkv_Ks?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). This is a big one, and I’m really hoping we get a good crowd, so please consider attending.
* The evening will be catered by our friends at Inca Social and feature performances from Iranian-American activist and the world’s only female ambidextrous violinist [Vienna Lionheart](https://us.list-manage.com/WeyPMZaFzpt?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Vienna’s story of escaping oppression in Iran is inspirational, and you will want to be there to hear it.
* The event is also honoring the memory of artist and USAID officer Joe Connors, and will feature a silent auction of some of his art pieces. Our host for the evening will be Anne Ralte, Joe’s widow and herself a casualty of the DOGE purges and destruction of USAID.
* These are good people, and I’m honored by their support. Even if you don’t want to meet me, come meet them.

* **Sunday, June 28th** \- 3PM, FCDC Virginia’s 8th District Candidate Debate! Franconia Government Center in Alexandria. [Register here.](https://us.list-manage.com/wBYYaBkqouV?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) This is the first debate! I’m nervous as hell! Please come attend if you can, and help me through my stage fright. Honestly, the conversation should be illuminating. This is the first time all the VA08 candidates will share the same space, so could be a disaster or it could be great. Let’s see! Unpredictability is the spice of life! And if I am one thing...

That’s the update for the latter half of this week. Hope to see y’all out there. As always, if you can, [please consider donating to the campaign](https://us.list-manage.com/tE0gIDQysF3?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) so I can pay my team a fair wage, get our message out there effectively, and afford both lunch AND dinner. On the same day! I know! Luxurious.
We’re in the home stretch ahead of August 4th. Every little bit helps. Appreciate you all, and feel free to hit me with any questions. I’m here for it.
Adam Duniganwww.Adam4Congress.com

Overturning _Roe_ was just the beginning for the anti-abortion far right. In the last four years, Republicans have been pushing some truly dystopian policies, like:
* Pushing fetal personhood bills that would give a fetus the same rights as a human being and outlaw not just abortion but birth control and IVF, too.

* Letting hospitals deny pregnant women lifesaving care during medical emergencies.

* And even urging the EPA to label mifepristone as a water pollutant in a backdoor attempt to ban medication abortion.

These laws have NOTHING to do with protecting life or the environment and EVERYTHING to do with controlling women’s bodies and lives.
**Republicans are clear that the chaos and nightmare they have created for women in America is not enough. They are still fighting to rip away women’s rights, and so we have to keep fighting, too.**
The best way to fight back is to flip the Senate in November, take back Congress, and make sure Republicans’ absurd and cruel conspiracy theories about abortion don’t end up becoming law.

America has a pro-choice majority, and we need to vote like it in November.

Hello Peter,
One of the most important qualities in a leader is the ability to listen and problem-solve together. Listening to voters, regardless of affiliation, economic background, or location, is the only way we, as a country, can make significant change.
We have just finished our first week of town halls in the district, and it has been rejuvenating to see how many people want to be involved in this democratic process. People are eager for answers and want to be part of the solution. We just need to give them the chance.
My platform was not built along party lines or under the eye of party bosses; it was shaped by the conversations and problems we face right here in NC-13. My opponent is a far-right MAGA extremist who votes with his party every time, regardless of how it impacts the folks back home.
It's been a long time since we had an independent voice in Congress, representing the needs of the people in our community. I plan to stand up to the corruption in Washington and make sure that the folks back home are taken care of.
I need your help to make sure we can get there. The end of this month marks another huge deadline for this campaign. We need to show up stronger than ever at the end of June to show we’re ready for much-needed change. Will you make a donation to help me reach voters across NC-13? Hi Peter,

Since the Dobbs decision four years ago today, 41 states have enforced abortion bans with few exceptions, and 13 of these states have total abortion bans.

Guess which states haven’t passed these laws? States with majority-women legislatures - Nevada, Colorado, and New Mexico, where reproductive health care is protected. And, Virginia (where Emerge alums make up nearly a quarter of the state assembly) is the last southern state to not pass any anti-abortion laws.

At Emerge, this anniversary always makes us mad... and motivated. _And that makes the work ahead really clear._

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Yesterday, we defeated AIPAC and the corporate-backed establishment in two
Democratic primary races, sending 5-term incumbent Rep. Adriano Espaillat
into retirement.

Now, 15-term Do-Nothing Democrat Rep. Diana DeGette is next.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260624-mk.--Rclm&refcode=em20260624-37947&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=37947%2E1203867%2ED88X0u ]Quote Tweet from @MelatKirosCO: "Denver. On June 30, we're unseating a
30yr incumbent. Tap in below and help us bring this home!"; Melat is quote
tweeting a tweet from @OsseChi that says: "Wait omg this is so fun! Who's
next???"

families in Congress alongside Darializa Avila Chevalier and Claire
Vasquez: split a donation to her campaign and Justice Democrats to help us
win next Tuesday’s primary!

In less than one week, Denver voters will decide whether they want more of
the status quo from DeGette or a bold new leader committed to ending
corruption, lowering costs for families, and guaranteeing healthcare for
all.

For 30 years, DeGette has been part of the political establishment that
keeps asking families to settle for next to nothing while corporations and
special interests get exactly what they want. She’s built a career
protecting a broken system — and now she expects to be handed another two
years in the halls of power.

But Justice Democrat Melat Kiros isn’t buying it.

Melat is challenging DeGette in CO-01 because working-class Coloradans
can’t afford more excuses from establishment politicians as health care
costs soar, rents skyrocket, and billionaires keep getting richer — all
while our tax dollars are used to commit war crimes and genocide overseas
and DeGette is bankrolled by the very real estate and Big Pharma lobbies
raising our prices.

Melat believes the government should put people first. That’s why she’s
running on Medicare for All, universal childcare, housing as a human
right, ending genocide and forever wars, and getting corporate money out
of politics for good.

DeGette has been in office since 1997, the year Melat was born, yet she
has little to show for it. She dares to call herself a progressive while
being propped up by Big Pharma, the real estate lobby, and corporate PACs
— a perfect example of why so many Democratic voters feel abandoned by
their own party.

DeGette just told a reporter that she’s “feeling pretty good” about
winning this primary next Tuesday. After last night’s primary results, she
shouldn’t be.

Voters are sick and tired of the Democratic Party’s feckless excuses and
defense of business as usual for the benefit of their corporate donors.
Democratic Party bosses, corporate stooges, and the oligarchs who fund
them see that, and they’re PANICKING.

Like Jamaal Bowman said last night, “The establishment better be afraid.
And guess what: next week, Melat Kiros is going to win in Colorado.”

Coloradans deserve better, and defeating DeGette, just like we defeated
Espaillat, is how we build a Party that fights for working people again.
With less than a week to Election Day, every voter we reach could make the
difference.

But Melat isn't relying on corporate PACs or billionaire donors to get
across the finish line. She's counting on this grassroots movement — she’s
counting on you,
Peter.

Melat Kiros today? Together we can once again show that no seat — and no
incumbent — is entitled to our votes.

Let’s go win another one!

body:
An even in Nelson County tonight, and the start of early voting.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/903bcaf73799/why-me-17292925?e=bd44204496)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/xJiHQsylhpL?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)
| | | | | |
# It Has Begun
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

[](https://us.list-manage.com/TRKnGt0lhsq?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

First things first: There’s a [candidate’s forum tonight](https://us.list-manage.com/sDnTA5wslit?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) in Nelson County. If you’re in that area, or if you don’t mind driving to Lovingston this evening—it’s a very nice drive—you should check it out. All three Democratic candidates for Congress will be there, and we’ll be addressing the audience in what was described to me as a “candidate speed-dating” format, which sounds fun. But maybe that’s just because I’ve never actually done speed-dating.
This is part of a general ramping up of the primary campaign, which also includes the fact that I’ve been getting questionnaires from Fifth District media and activist groups. See the one [posted by Charlottesville Tomorrow](https://us.list-manage.com/LnqT6D3OTNZ?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), which will allow you to compare my answers to those of my rivals.
The first question was perfectly pitched for my campaign, so you can imagine my answer:
_“**Congress and presidential powers:** Multiple 5th District voters who responded to our voter survey expressed concerns about whether Congress is doing enough to hold presidents accountable. Congress can investigate federal agencies, require officials to testify before Congress, and limit how federal money is spent, among other powers. Under what circumstances would you support Congress using those powers to challenge a president’s actions?_
“**Rob Tracinski:** Congress should ALWAYS be using its powers, and the fact that they aren’t—and even some Democrats seem to have forgotten how—is the entire reason I’m running. The U.S. Congress is a good idea, and it would be nice if we had one. Congress has the power to decide when we go to war (or not), to set tariffs, to dictate what money gets spent and what agencies exist, and to remove officials who abuse their power. We should get started on doing all of those things.”

I’m expecting more of these to be posted soon, and I’ll let you know when I see them.
But the big news of the past few days is that IT HAS BEGUN. That’s always a dramatic way to announce things, and in this case, it fits. What has begun is early voting, and I was pleased to discover that I’m listed first on the ballot. Supposedly that’s worth a couple extra percentage points, and it was decided by random draw, so that was a bit of luck.

I can also report that I took an early lead in voting in Louisa County. Last Thursday morning, my wife, my son, and I were the second, third, and fourth voters in the county. I don’t want to take their votes for granted, but I’m pretty confident that put me in the lead, for at least a little while.
If you want to keep me in the lead, go to vote early. In most counties and cities, it’s held at the registrar’s office during normal business hours.
I’ve also been [fielding questions on social media](https://us.list-manage.com/EOxJl8ZCsx7?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) from people who are getting their mail-in ballots.
And of course, please reply to this e-mail if you want to put up yard signs, or if you have time to volunteer for the campaign.

### A Candidate’s Guide to the Candidates

One of the things I did to mark the beginning of early voting was to post [my own guide to the candidates in the district](https://us.list-manage.com/PgJQmLimyto?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), both Democrats and Republicans, to show where I fit it in.
It’s not exactly a neutral guide, but I hope it’s an honest one. Note also this pitch that I made to non-Democratic voters.
“Right now, today, after the disastrous war Trump started with Iran and a peace deal that is just an American surrender on every issue—now is possibly the worst time to announce that you don’t think anyone ever needs to ask any questions or offer any resistance to what Trump is doing.
“So that’s my final pitch, not just to Democrats but to Independents and even to Republicans, people who have not traditionally voted in the Democratic primary. Remember, Virginia is an open primary state. You don’t have to be a registered Democrat. You decide when you show up at the registrar’s office or when you show up at the polls what primary you want to vote in.
“There’s no alternative offered in the Republican primary. So if you’re starting to think that maybe Donald Trump is kind of making a mess of things, if you think it would be a good idea if we had a functioning Congress that isn’t just his personal rubber stamp, if you’re looking for a reasonable alternative, someone who is really just trying to restore the normal constitutional order—then you should hop over into the Democratic primary and vote for me. Look, I never thought, before ten years ago, I never though I would run as a Democrat, so it’s not so crazy to think that maybe you could vote for a Democrat, if only just this once. Think about it.
“And if you didn’t need so much convincing to think that Trump is going off the rails—vote for the one person in this race who is most focused on fixing our constitutional system so we won’t have a president—any president—go off the rails like this again in the future.”
That’s a good message, and people are responding to it. name: Andrew
subject: With deep gratitude
body:
Right now, election officials are continuing to count the remaining mail-in ballots. There are still tens of thousands of votes left to count, and we expect a clearer picture of the data tomorrow and over the coming days.

| Peter,

After Early Voting and Election Day votes and the initial mail-in ballots counted, I want to reach out and share an update on where our race stands, and more importantly, express my profound gratitude for your unwavering support.

When we started this campaign, we set out with a clear, urgent vision: to build a Montgomery County that is truly affordable, accessible, and full of opportunity for everyone who calls it home. We gave voice to the working families, small business owners, and residents who want to see this community thrive today and for generations to come. We began as a clear underdog against better known opponents. But together, we built a countywide coalition of firefighters, retired teachers, housing advocates, police officers, nonprofit, community, and elected leaders from every level of government who shared our vision and message which resonated with voters throughout Montgomery County.

Whether you knocked on doors, made phone calls, contributed financially, or shared our vision with your neighbors, you poured your heart and soul into this effort. I am forever grateful for your steadfast belief and dedication to our collective future.

Right now, election officials are continuing to count the remaining mail-in ballots with tens of thousands of votes pending. We will have a clearer picture of where things stand over the coming days, with additional counts expected tomorrow and Saturday.

While we are committed to ensuring every vote is counted and every voice is heard, and know we've been leading the mail-in voting, the math ahead of us is undeniably difficult. We will continue to watch the returns closely and will keep you updated as the Board of Elections updates their counts.

No matter what the ultimate tally shows, my belief in the incredible potential of Montgomery County remains unshaken. Together, we forced a desperately needed conversation about affordability and the need to lower costs and create jobs. Our campaign message resonated and because of you, it became the central theme of the public conversation. I could not be prouder of the campaign we ran together, and I remain incredibly humbled and honored to stand with you to make Montgomery County a more affordable and economically competitive place.

Thank you for everything, [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133952055/629617962/-1721553747?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-06-24_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzNjMmU2My0xNTcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d2PxeJes__J2bdmwAGXds9Umsm9NkO4_CPTV2mkyqJY=)

name: Hanks for Colorado
subject: Proven Service over Polished Mailers
body:
My Appeal to Western and Southern Colorado

| | | | | [|
---](https://hanksforcolorado.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8015ade0e781cf96f029a35b&id=722db33fa7&e=934ceb4302)
| | | | | | **Proven Service over Polished Mailers****My Appeal to Western & Southern Colorado**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
My Fellow Conservatives,
If the system was working, I wouldn’t be running.
If we had a real conservative in office, I would be applauding him. But we don’t. We have a 59% “F” rated Republican who has strayed from our conservative values. Mailers by the dozen and phony social media posts don’t change his voting record. His Big Money handlers hope you’ll read “conservative” on a mailer and believe it long enough to vote for him.
President Trump has the agenda to clean up Washington, strengthen the economy and secure our nation. But he has just two years left to get it done. Our congressman has already slowed Trump down — and has zero obligation to do better. Worse still, Trump has no leverage over our “F” rated congressman going forward.
Agreements break easily in Washington. Look at Senator Thune blocking the SAVE Act — a bill 85% of Americans support. We’ve seen our trust broken here in CD3 as well. Just a few months ago, President Trump pulled his endorsement of our “F” rated congressman for breaking his trust.
Years ago, Ronald Reagan framed the right question: Are you better off today than you were two years ago?
Do you think the federal government should lock up more of our land? Put kill switches in your vehicles so bureaucrats decide if you can drive? Hide sexual misconduct cases involving members of Congress? Send more of our money to corrupt and unstable Ukraine? Take away President Trump’s tariff authority? Protect Ilhan Omar’s committee seats at the expense of Congress’s integrity? Let New York lawyers and D.C. lobbyists pour outside money into our races to buy the outcomes they want?
Because those are the positions of our “F” rated, NeverSeen/NeverHeard representative.
If you answer “Yes” to those questions, then you know for whom to cast your vote.
If your answers are “No” then I ask you to vote for me, **Ron Hanks** – on the **Top Line** of the ballot – to move the America First agenda as far as we can in the next two years.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
**MY COMMITMENT IS DEMONSTRATED AND ABSOLUTE**
I am a 32-year Air Force veteran who served as an Arabic linguist and Intelligence Officer. President Reagan was my first Commander in Chief. President Trump was my last. Service across four decades as a Citizen-Soldier cemented my faith in what this nation can and should be.
I served in the Colorado House as a Citizen-Legislator. While I was there I:
* Earned my “A” rating defending our 2nd Amendment – drafting bills for Constitutional Carry and to repeal magazine capacity limits.
* Drafted Election Integrity bills that pre-date the SAVE Act.
* Stood up for the unborn in the longest floor fight in Colorado history.
* Sought funding for water tanks for rural areas to fight wildfires more quickly and efficiently.

I have real-world experience that applies directly to our district. I’ve worked the oilfields in North Dakota, planted saplings in timber country, served in a volunteer fire department. I still run heavy equipment, and I still hold my trucker’s license.
I am beholden to no special interests. I seek no endorsements except from the voters of this district.
I have signed the Tax Pledge (from ATR), the Right to Work pledge, and the Term Limits pledge.
I have SHOWN UP for media interviews. My opponent has refused to do them – a direct insult to YOU, the voters of this district.
I offer unwavering conservative representation. I will represent this district in Washington, meet regularly with constituents, provide clear updates, listen closely to your concerns and seek your ideas for solutions.
President Trump needs fighters in Congress who will deliver America First in his final two years — not fake conservatives who work against him, in servitude to their Big Money handlers.
I am easy to find on the ballot. I’m **Top Line** on the ballot because I stood before the Republican Assembly. The other guy ran away.
I’m **Ron Hanks** , and I humbly ask for your vote. _Respectfully,__Ron_[ www.HanksForColorado.com](https://hanksforcolorado.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8015ade0e781cf96f029a35b&id=b50bb1625d&e=934ceb4302)

Hi,
This upcoming FEC deadline on the 30th is a big one – so my team and I set a big goal: **$3 million.**

body:
| Trump is holding housing relief hostage over his election conspiracy theories.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9891%2E5257348%2ESkVoZL)
Derek, it’s hard to believe this just happened. An hour before he was set to sign the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, the biggest housing bill in 30 years, Donald Trump just canceled the bill signing. I helped champion this bill written by Elizabeth Warren. And have been pushing to build millions more homes and to cut red tape so we could finally bring down the cost of housing. For years, this has been priority number one. And we finally got it through the Senate, where it passed 85-5, and through the House, where it passed 358-32. A bill that would boost housing supply, crack down on private equity firms buying up single-family homes, and help families still rebuilding after the LA wildfires. It is as bipartisan as legislation gets in this Congress. And then — Trump just walked away from it. Why? Because he wants to hold housing relief hostage over his own election conspiracy theories and demands that Congress pass the SAVE Act — a bill designed to make it harder for citizens to register and vote. Trump said the quiet part out loud, calling our housing bill “of minor importance” next to his voter suppression bill, which he’s labeled a “national emergency.” Derek, that tells you everything about what matters to him. Not your housing costs. Not the families still digging out from the wildfires. Only his grip on power and the next election, which he fears losing. Badly. Senate Republicans, as usual, are sitting idly by, letting Trump throw his tantrums as he sacrifices the financial well-being of American families over his petty grievances. body:

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133952454/629619022/526203646?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjczYmJmMC0xNTcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WmarZCknjKVCb52bxMxVuQEimf4mAqBqxVzxP6G0feA=)
Peter, It’s been a chilling four years since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned by the Supreme Court. The ruling in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ was an attack on freedom of choice in this country. It was an unprecedented elimination of a previously guaranteed constitutional right. And since the Dobbs decision, anti-choice extremists have taken full advantage of the ruling by making life absolute Hell for millions of women across red states. In fact, people began flocking to Illinois – including IL-17 – for reproductive care after it was outlawed in several surrounding states following the _Dobbs_ ruling. One thing is clear: it's never been more urgent that we retake and hold a majority in Congress in order to pass bills like the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would codify _Roe v. One day. That's how long it took.
Tucker Carlson announced he's done with the Republican Party -- no more supporting GOP candidates, an independent man of conscience now, too principled for the party that made him. It pissed off Donald Trump, Ted Cruz, and everyone else who relies on Tucker Carlson's audience to keep their failed movement alive.
Then, before the story had even faded, he went right back to gushing about JD Vance. How much he loves him. What a great man he is. How Vance is the obvious choice to lead the GOP into 2028, the only one who can carry Trump's legacy forward.
So which is it?
You're done with the Republican Party, but you're doing unpaid advance work for its most likely next nominee? That's not independence. That's a hostage video with good lighting and it exposes the MAGA movement at it's core.
This is the shell game these guys play, and I am exhausted by it. They pose as brave outsiders, too pure for partisan politics -- and then carry water for the same party they pretend to have outgrown. They want the credibility of the rebel and the access of the loyalist at the same time. I'm not buying it, and after this week nobody should.
* * *
**Today 's rant is sponsored by Ground News.**
I've been paying more attention to how differently the same story gets covered depending on where you read it--especially lately, when everything feels optimized for speed and outrage instead of context.
Take this one--hundreds of outlets picked up reports that the Pentagon is seeking $80 billion from Congress for a war with Iran.
**The Wrap** says _Trump lashed out at a female reporter who questioned the cost of a potential Iran war amid concerns for 'financially struggling' Americans_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/765db12e-d14d-4cb5-9cb3-c1591e7c47e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Jewish Insider** states _the administration is planning an $80 billion supplemental funding request tied to the Iran war._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/765db12e-d14d-4cb5-9cb3-c1591e7c47e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Same story--completely different narratives.

That's why I use Ground News. It pulls together 50,000+ sources so you can compare coverage side by side, see political bias, who owns the sources you're reading, how reliable they are and understand how framing changes the story.

See how the left and right cover the same story, what each side emphasizes or leaves out, and discover overlooked stories in the Blindspot Feed, which surfaces coverage disproportionately reported by either side.

I've been a paying user since before they ever sponsored Endless Urgency. I use it because it makes it a lot harder to be misled. They're completely subscriber funded so there are no corporate interests pushing a narrative on what you see.

See the full picture, instead of just one angle with Ground News. [Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/765db12e-d14d-4cb5-9cb3-c1591e7c47e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
The most revealing reaction to all of this came from Nick Fuentes, who accused Tucker Carlson of stealing his playbook. Normally I wouldn't waste time on these two -- Fuentes is a racist, sexist, anti-Semitic little shit weasel, and Tucker has spent years poisoning our politics in a more polished package. But this fight tells us something about the moment MAGA is in.
Tucker Carlson is a creature of the Republican Party. He's GOP royalty -- his father served in multiple Republican administrations, he built his career inside conservative institutions, spent years at Fox News, spent years attacking Democrats and defending Republicans whenever it suited him. The Vance worship is the tell. You don't quit a movement and then anoint its next leader. A man actually done with the GOP wouldn't have a favorite candidate to run it.
For all his sudden anger that Trump isn't truly "America First," Tucker had no problem being a happy foot soldier when it paid. He sold the Iraq War for years. He attacked Obama and Biden for trying to end it. He carried water for the movement he now wants you to believe he's outgrown. That's why I doubt this entire performance.
I agree with some of the criticism -- the GOP doesn't represent average Americans, and Trump has exposed himself as someone who never meant the promises he made his own voters. But Tucker didn't discover that because he grew a conscience. He discovered it because Trump is weaker than he used to be, and Tucker sees an opening.
That's what Fuentes understands. And again -- Fuentes is a neo-Nazi piece of shit, and nobody should mistake this for praise. But he sees Tucker copying the strategy he's run for years: build independence from the establishment, attack the party as corrupt and weak, cultivate a young angry audience, then use that influence to drag the movement even further in your direction. The only difference is Tucker knows how to make it sound _slightly_ more respectable.
* * *
**Mid-rant note: this section is sponsored by Ground News.**
I've started paying more attention to how the same story can feel completely different depending on who's reporting it. Ground News makes that easy to see by showing coverage from across the political spectrum and pointing out what certain outlets leave out.
My team and I use it because it helps cut through the noise.
**[See every side of every story with Ground News->](https://substack.com/redirect/765db12e-d14d-4cb5-9cb3-c1591e7c47e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
_Try it today!_
[ Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/765db12e-d14d-4cb5-9cb3-c1591e7c47e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Here's the real story: Donald Trump is weak. He can still win a primary like he did with Massie and make Republicans embarrass themselves on command. But he cannot hold this movement together. A powerful leader wouldn't have Tucker Carlson, Nick Fuentes, Candace Owens, and every other MAGA influencer jockeying for position in broad daylight. The emperor has no clothes.
So when Tucker Carlson says he's done with the GOP, do not fall for it. He told you the truth one day later, with his own mouth, when he started campaigning for JD Vance. He's not abandoning the Republican Party -- he's auditioning for a bigger role in it, testing how much power he has over it.
This is a jump ball for the future of the right, and the people reaching for it are some of the worst in the country. Every one of them wants you to believe they're independent free thinkers while they line up behind the same party and the same playbook. Don't let them launder it. Watch what they do, not what they say -- and be ready to stop these people before they drive this country even further into the ditch.
P.S. Anytime a story feels like it's missing context, it probably is. Here's a question worth asking:

**Why don't we have a champion for Medicare for All in one of the bluest seats in California?**
Part of the answer is the money. Our incumbent, Doris Matsui, takes contributions from insurance companies and big pharma — and when your campaign is funded by a corporate credit card, you have a debt to pay. You won't move with urgency on the issues that actually matter to working families.
This gets at something bigger. There's a reason the Democratic Party lost to Trump twice: too much of the Party has grown out of touch with the people it's supposed to serve. And you can't fix that just by being anti-Trump. We have to show people what we're actually fighting for.
So let me tell you what I'm fighting for. Working families — the people living paycheck to paycheck after 20 years of the same representation, people my age who are no closer to owning a home, the next generation inheriting a world they didn't create. They deserve a seat at the table, and that's who I answer to.
That's the campaign we've built. I have never taken a dime from corporate PACs, and I never will.

Mai is the daughter of Hmong refugees, born and raised in Sacramento. Mai’s parents fled war in Laos and arrived in California to find a new life.

Team,
**Dan Meuser just said that our economy "has never been better."**
Maybe it's never been better for his own stock portfolio, or for the billionaires he handed a huge tax break to.
**But for just once, I 'd like Dan to think about how things are going for the rest of us.**
For the people who got kicked off their health insurance because he voted to double their premiums.
Or for the families struggling to put food on the table because grocery prices just saw the highest spike in years.
Or for the thousands of his constituents dealing with skyrocketing energy bills and paying top dollar to put gas in their cars.
**For those of us who aren 't worth $69 million like Dan, it sure doesn't feel like the economy "has never been better."**
He can say what he wants on national TV, but we see the truth every time we open our wallets. We can't afford another two years of Dan Meuser in Congress.

Peter, **Remember the Brett Kavanaugh confirmation fight?** Justice Kennedy retired right before the midterm elections during Trump’s first term. It was completely strategic—it gave Trump the opportunity to appoint a successor before the American people could vote in a Congress that would block him. The successor? Brett Kavanaugh. Younger, more extreme, and even more loyal to corrupt and wealthy elites. Ready to entrench corruption for the decades he has left to sit on the Court. **And they want to do it all over again. Reports indicate that both Justices Alito and Thomas are considering retiring—and they could do so soon, right before this November’s midterm elections.** **That means We the People need to prepare for another Kavanaugh-style confirmation fight, and fast. We can’t let the wealthy elites keep rigging the Court and our system in the shadows.** [**United for Democracy is building the people-powered coalition that will fight back the minute Alito or Thomas announce their retirements. clean_body: The next move extremist elites will make to lock in their power? Replacing Alito and Thomas. | | Peter, Remember the Brett Kavanaugh confirmation fight? Justice Kennedy retired right before the midterm elections during Trump’s first term. It was completely strategic—it gave Trump the opportunity to appoint a successor before the American people could vote in a Congress that would block him. The successor? Brett Kavanaugh. Younger, more extreme, and even more loyal to corrupt and wealthy elites. Ready to entrench corruption for the decades he has left to sit on the Court. And they want to do it all over again. Reports indicate that both Justices Alito and Thomas are considering retiring—and they could do so soon, right before this November’s midterm elections. That means We the People need to prepare for another Kavanaugh-style confirmation fight, and fast. We can’t let the wealthy elites keep rigging the Court and our system in the shadows. ** There’s a reason why our power has been stripped down to nothing. Why our healthcare is being cut to give billionaires tax breaks. Why we can’t afford gas, groceries, and rent while corporations reap massive profits. Why our voting rights are chipped away every day. It’s because wealthy extremists have captured every part of our system, and rigged it against us in their favor. The Supreme Court is the best example of this. The captured Roberts Court has time and time again ruled against the everyday, working people they are supposed to represent. Alito and Thomas themselves have both been caught hiding their connections to and gifts from Wall Street billionaires. We have to be prepared to stand up to more packing of the Supreme Court once and for all. If Thomas or Alito (or both) retire, the power of the people is the only thing standing in the way of younger, more extreme successors who will rule against the Constitution for decades to come.** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Thank you for being on retirement watch with us, Morgan Stahr United for Democracy Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . subject: Four years ago today
body:

Peter,

Four years ago, the Supreme Court ripped away the federal constitutional
right to abortion that generations fought to secure.

In its gut-wrenching 2022 Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization
ruling, the Court overturned Roe v. Wade and opened the floodgates for the
far-right to attack reproductive rights across the country.

Since then, we’ve seen exactly what’s at stake.

Women denied critical medical care. Doctors forced to choose between
treating their patients’ health and risking prosecution. Families
suffering — and, in some cases, losing loved ones — because extremist
politicians decided they should control our bodies and our futures.

And they aren’t stopping at abortion.

The same far-right movement that celebrated Dobbs is working every day to
erode privacy rights, restrict access to contraception, undermine
gender-affirming care, and roll back hard-fought freedoms. This is the
same movement emboldened by Trump’s rhetoric calling for a “baby boom,”
while pushing policies that make it harder to raise children.

The Squad is not backing down.

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida have always fought for reproductive
freedom, bodily autonomy, and every person’s right to make their own
healthcare decisions.

They’re working to secure safe, legal, affordable abortion access, family
planning services, quality pre- and post-natal care, and a future where
healthcare is a right — not a privilege.

And because they refuse to stay silent, they’re constant targets of
right-wing attacks.

Today, on the four-year anniversary of the Dobbs ruling, we’re asking you
to stand with our progressive champions in this fight.

name: Cynthia Duran
subject: Don’t let Letitia James destroy my husband!
body:
| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e13988818/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvYlg3SnVGckJEcA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MjQ/LbmNsbDRHRjltOQ/qP2hpZHM9bmN2UjRTWkRadEJRejBscw/gajxZFQ/s1v2dfd6174)
| | | Dear Friend, I know you and I have never met. But I’m writing to you today because I’m desperate. [**And in the next 48 hours, I need your help to stop New York Attorney General Letitia James. before she tears my family apart and locks my police officer husband up for the next NINE YEARS for doing his job.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | | This is Erik, me, and our three children in the family photo. I wish I didn’t have to blur our faces. But with the death threats we’ve been getting, I couldn’t afford to take any chances. I should explain... You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer who was speeding a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk. That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.” After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in. The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet.
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[Click Here to support Erik!](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | | When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect. Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed. So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late. Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died. But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe. And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang... He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play... He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger... But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. **You see, Leticia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does.** And five months after that fateful day... ...she charged Erik with Manslaughter. She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus. They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents. What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial. But not only did the judge find Erik guilty... ...he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison. The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers! This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people. It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age. But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. He grew up in the Bronx. His family and friends still live in the area. Erik always told me how proud he was that he got to go to work every day and help get the drugs, guns and crime out of his neighborhood. And when we were getting ready for the trial, we got a flood of letters from people who lived there. Letter after letter talked about how Erik is a man with a heart for the community. But most importantly, he’s a wonderful husband and an incredible dad to our three children. Telling them their father was going to prison was the hardest thing I’ve ever done. Our five-year-old couldn’t understand. Daddy was a police officer. He was one of the good guys. Why would he go to jail? After he was sentenced, Erik was locked up in Riker’s Island in awful conditions. He spent his days in solitary confinement in a dark, filthy cell with blood all over the walls. This is how Letitia James and Judge Guy Mitchell repaid my husband for 15 years of protecting his neighborhood. It’s disgusting. It’s unjust. And it’s just plain wrong. Thankfully, Erik’s lawyers told us he has a good chance at an appeal. And after we filed the appeal, the court set Erik free on bond. But as you know, the appeals process is incredibly expensive. I had almost given up hope. But thank the Lord, Erik is a godly man. Through it all, his faith has never wavered -- not once. On his way home from prison, he stopped at our local church to pray and ask God for help. [**And God brought us the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) You know that LELDF helps innocent law enforcement officers -- and their families -- fight for justice when there’s nowhere else to turn. Thanks to kind-hearted people like you, they get these officers the lawyers and expert witnesses they need to fight back against activist prosecutors and judges... ...and win. My friend, you’ve already read my email this far, so I’m going to come right out and ask: **[Will you be an answer to prayer too? Will you make a $35 gift to LELDF to help fund Erik’s appeal?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** I know it’s strange to ask for your support in the very first email I’ve ever written you. But we have nowhere else to turn. Erik and I come from working-class families. We’re not wealthy. And with Erik being found guilty, we lost his salary and our medical benefits. We’re barely getting by as it is. **[So any amount you can donate today to help Erik fight back against Letitia James and clear his name -- whether it’s $35, $50, $100, $500, or even $5,000 -- is such a blessing to our family.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)And because LELDF is a nonprofit, your gift is tax-deductible too. But whatever God is prompting you to give, please act quickly. Erik’s legal team needs to be working around the clock on this appeal. Because if we don’t fight this injustice, Erik will be imprisoned. And you know how police officers are treated in prison. And when you access the secure donation page, you’ll see there is a box where you can type a message—[**can I ask you to write a brief note of support to Erik?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) If you’re a believer like Erik, maybe you could write a short prayer. I know it will mean the world to him. My friend, for the past three years Erik told me something over and over again: “It’s not about the hardships. It’s about the people God sends into your life during difficult times to help you.” I pray that today you’ll be one of those people God uses to help our family. Thank you, and God Bless,
---
**_Cynthia Duran_**
---
P.S. My husband doesn’t deserve this. He’s a decorated police officer who spent his entire career serving and protecting his city. That day in the park, he saved lives. And for that, Letitia James wants him locked him up for NINE YEARS. Please don’t let the cop-haters destroy another good man. **[Make your tax-deductible gift as soon as you can. And when you make your gift, please write a prayer or note of support in the message box on the secure donation page.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
|
---
_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit leldf.org. And remember –Blue Lives Matter!_ © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | [www.PoliceDefense.org](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303

Hi Peter

Joe Males here. USMC Vet. And before anything else - a family man.

**Let me show you who I am really fighting for:**

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=cfd09aa697e648469d22a7e9353cedb8&_e=hwC77eFdzsC3wo_h0suPGGqf2AK7Tp5iEouTStdWfOIHy5d03axub8sukBGOC1Wx7QOeOe5z-iTQCuJKyUALbnPSn6FvXXHFDNWsqAI2SMdwoFjEFG1Glk1icqsOzve-jbWrXjOVSdscGALNs_MjJid_eo98nvzam7yAE3_d06Au8T3uDQoSE8zNMq4_3YfCMEm5EZKTHr0UbXe6G45-F-5j921OpC3bvCM4ev-B0x3tvVtF9ujRe33Cl2l9jJuOagRT3tj90jnGDdFpAtfgK0jqiWaHIH2OdbopFsfdX1RNQnkUgD_65hbrW5kqS0H1CQWfGCLocla5hkt5_N7_31KjeijE0BBKc9VRBjFxlqNquaQS2M2h_UHujioD-JCWVImYmGH-cxJa9WII5-zuxO7tm-h9SYOp4_706aJe9T1zIc_h5AdAdUPHdj1GevVmlf15MDnUZ38Vytbd5KxXCubvCVpEr0uP9G9hHVRbIzxW-2-EFENjvOOa_CaqedOe-yN2mmHLIuH-wwCSYsfPBg%3D%3D)
It’s the faces in this picture. My family. The people I would go to war for - without hesitation. Without second thoughts.

But it doesn’t stop at my front door. _**[Because the truth is, I am fighting for all of California - every family, every neighbor, every hard-working citizen in this district.](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=cfd09aa697e648469d22a7e9353cedb8&_e=hwC77eFdzsC3wo_h0suPGGqf2AK7Tp5iEouTStdWfOIHy5d03axub8sukBGOC1Wx7QOeOe5z-iTQCuJKyUALbnPSn6FvXXHFDNWsqAI2SMdwoFjEFG1Glk1icqsOzve-mYo-wEtdPnena0Xt4rggu9jRBWW9CfA1cYyBwbtm5Pb6Uz7X0soRexTvjVOD7tuW5m2QYtt2nHP-slP_W9n_uSeC7B1STp0dVoqR4EdWGWXwkj4LOL-oxVtUEPFHgg1t65t7AghI_lnez_jfI0RRXQE8zAlxf3i7WQnPhhl0UoB_gP9HZnNIlT2CfX1V3uiqP53FwiYFcLkmuPm3yxo3lwGIFdkGdwXb2ZhtVHTSryPW9NB21WjYK-QS3tSBI4qaiCY0vrMlMjDzIqmYwaRnp-3ZRMa4FS6MsafYFsJ1FMFKIRz2E_6WwxI1arVa2KtG9O9pV5rF3hoyDzzVD-EvPR5GluJer8LAXZNY4PnE6ksIiuJxlRk55q-BURggcUij6p1i61KOfOW6sjFAnv1Mu53SUBUdb9Qk3nqsg0w8JM8%3D)**_

And beyond that, I am fighting for this country because I already swore an oath to defend it once, and I’ve never stopped living by it.

Washington forgot people like us. To them, it is about districts, donors, and headlines.

I’m running to change that - for our troops, our veterans, and for our families.

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]
